tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed

dmar po lha lnga'i bdag nyid can gyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga 'khrul ba'i dri bral bzhugs/ oṃ swā sti/ bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed dmar po lha lnga'i bdag nyid can gyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga 'khrul ba'i dri bral zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi zung 'jug ye shes me chen gyis/ /dus min 'chi dang 'tshe ba sna tshogs dang*/ /gnyis snang rlung gi rgyu ba bcas 'joms pa/ khro rgyal dus kyi dgra bo la btud nas/ /dang po'i las can rnams la nyer mkho'i phyir/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga 'dus gsal go bde ba/ / gzhan la phan pa'i bsam pas 'dir 'chad kyi/ /bla ma lhag pa'i lha yis dge bar mdzod/ / 'dir gshin rje gshed dmar po lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga slob ma la dbang bskur ba'i bya ba dang bcas pa bshad par bya ste/ de la/ sa'i cho ga lhag par gnas pa/ dngos gzhi'i cho ga /rjes kyi bya ba ste bzhi las/ dang po la/ sa brtag pa spyi dang mthun yang*/ da lta lag len la mi byed pas/ de phyin chad ni/ 'di ltar bya ste/ sngon 'gro gtor ma la sogs pa 'og tu dgos pa'i mchod pa'i yo byad rnams tshogs par byas la/ las kyis rdo rjes sngon 'gro gtor ma'i zhu 'bul bya/ a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ lag pa g.yas dang*/ g.yon gnyis ka rim gyis bstan la/ oṃ āḥhūṃ zhes brjod/ hoḥ zhes bya khyung gi phyag rgya dang*/ hūṃ zhes 'chi med rnam rgyal gyi phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs skyong ba bcu srid pa gsum gyi 'byung po'i tshogs dang bcas pa dang*/ gnas bdag gzhi bdagayul bdag /grong bdag gnyug mar gnas pa thams cad badzra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ da sha dika lo ka pā la sa pa ri wa ra bhyaḥsarba kṣe tra pā le bhyaḥ sarba bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wa re bhyaḥ sarba bhū te bhyoḥ oṃ badzra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swāhā/ de bzhin du/ pādyaṃ

zhes sbyar te chu gnyis 'bul/ oṃ da sha dika sogs kyi mthar/ a kā ro btags pa lan gsum mam bco brgyad kyis 'bul/ de yang lag len/ gtor ma lcog zlum mtheb kyu bco brgyad kyis bskor ba byed cing*/ dbus ma de spyi bungs dang*/ bco brgyad po de rnams phyogs skyong bco lnga dang*/ zhing skyong dang*/ gzhi bdag dang*/ bgegs rnams la bsngo ba yin pas lan bco brgyad 'bul ba yin no/ /de nas oṃ da sha dika sogs kyi mthar puṣpe nas shapta 'i bar sbyar bas mchod/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ nas/ kun 'grub shog gi bar brjod/ sa'i phyogs 'dir sems can thams cad kyi don gyi phyir/ dpal gshin rje gshed dmar po lha lnga'i dky-il 'khor chen po legs par bzhengs te/ sgrub cing mchod pa dang*/ bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang bar 'tshal na/ dkar phyogs la dga' ba'i bsrung ma khyad par can khyed rnams kyis bar chad thams cad zhi zhing bsrung ba'i 'phrin las mdzad du gsol/ gang dag nag po'i phyogs la mngon par dga' ba'i 'byung po gdug pa can gsang spyod lta bar mi dbang ba thams cad gtor ma 'dis tshim pa gyis la/ sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song zhing*/ hrīḥṣtī drag tu bzla zhing*/ rdo rje bsor/ rol chen dang bcas te gtor ma gtsang sar btang ngo*/ / slob ma dbang bskur ram rab gnas kyi don yin na/ gong gi 'phrin bcol skabs/ bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang bskur ba'am/ slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur bar 'tshal na zhes pa'am/ sku gsung thugs kyi rten rab tu gnas par 'tshal na zhes 'don pa spo/ sngon 'gro gtor ma gshed bskor spyi dang mthun par byas kyang rung mod kyi/ glo bo lo tsā ba'i man ngag thun mong ma yin pa de nyid do/ /gnas yo byin rlabs kyi don du zhu 'bul byas la/ a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ gnas khang bhruṃ las rin po che las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhis mdzes pa/

mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su a las byung ba'i ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog /bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa mchod rdzas rnams/ rang bzhin bde stong gi ye shes/ rnam pa mchod rdzas kyi sprin phung*/ byed las rang bzhin gyi dbang po mtha' dag zag med kyis bde bas tshim par byed pa/ ngo bo kun tu bzang po'i rnam 'phrul las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin phung lta bu bzang zhing rgya che ba/ nam mkha'i mthas klas par gyur/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ swāhā/ oṃ pādyaṃ swāhā/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badzra dhu pe āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badzra ā lo ke āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badzra gandhe āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badzra nai wi te āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badzra shapta āḥhūṃ/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ badzra spha ra ṇa khaṃ lan gsum brjod/ rol chen dang bcas/ oṃ badzra ghaṇḍe ra ṇi ta/ saṃ pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba buddha kṣe tra pra tsa li te/ pradzñā pa ra ṇi ta/ na da saṃ bha we ta/ badzra dharma hṛ da ya/ santo ṣa ni/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ ho ho ho/ a khaṃ swāhā/ zhes lan gsum gyis byin dbab/ skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas/ shun+yā ta sa stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ rang sems hūm̐ las dbyug pa hūm̐ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das zhe sdang gshin rje gshed nas/ dmar mos 'khyud pa/ zhal cig phyag gnyis nas/ nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ yum rdo rje ro langs ma zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma nas/ yab la 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /yab kyi thugs kar ye shes sems dpa' dbyug pa dkar po/ zhes pa nas/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rdo rje sems dpas dbu brgyan/ zhes pa rnams kyi bar sgrub thabs bzhin brjod pa ste/ 'di ni lhan skyes kyi rnal 'byor rgyas pa'o/

/de nas hrīḥṣti cung zad bzlas la/ yungs kar dang thal ba cung zad bsres pa/ dkyil 'khor gyi sa phyogs su lan gsum gtor zhing*/ hrīḥṣtī lan gsum brjod/ ba byung gis byug cing*/ dri bzang gi chus bsang gtor byed bzhin du'ang hrīḥṣtī bzla/ slob dpon gyi lag pa gnyis dkyil 'khor gyi sa'i dbus su bzhag la/ oṃ bhu khaṃ/ lan gsum/ tha mal gyi sa gzhi nam mkha'i rang bzhin du gyur/ oṃ laṃ hūṃ/ lan gsum/ sa gzhi rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur/ oṃ me de ni badzri bha wa badzra bandha hūṃ/ lan gsum/ bskal pa'i bar du mi shigs shing brtan par gyur/ dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhir slob dpon 'dug /de'i phyogs bzhi nas mchod pa bshams/ dam tshig dang ldan pa bzhi phyogs bzhir rdo rje dang dril bu thogs pas 'dug /slob dpon gyis/ skyabs 'gro nas bzlas pa'i bar sgrub thabs rdzogs par sgom/ slob ma bzhi po'ang gti mug gshin rje gshed la sogs pa so so'i nga rgyal gyis gnas par byas la/ lhan cig tu bzlas pa cung zad cig bya'o/ /mchod pa rnams bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ a las byung ba'i ye shes kyi nas/ a khaṃ swāhā 'i bar gong bzhin/ slob dpon gshin rje gshed kyi dkyil 'khor du gsal ba la/ phul bar mos te/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swāhā/ oṃ badzra pādyaṃ pra titstsha swāhā/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐/ nas shapta 'i bar gyis mchod/ 'og thig tshon gyi skabs ltar/ gsang 'dus las 'byung ba'i de nyid lnga pas bstod/ de nas so sos gsol ba gdab pa ni/ bcu gsum ma'i dkyil chog ltar byas kyang rung mod kyi/ lag len la/ 'dus pa dang mthun par byed pa ni shin tu legs te/ 'od gsal 'char ba'i rim par/ dbang gi cho ga 'dus pa'i dkyil chog ltar bya bar slob dpon nyid kyi gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /des na/ dril sil dang bcas/ dbyangs kyis brjod pa'am/ min kyang rung te/ shar nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun zhi

ba/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /chos kun bdag med pa yi mchog / dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ / lho nas/ mtshan rnams thams cad yang dag rdzogs/ /mtshan min thams cad yang dag spangs/ /kun tu bzang po sku yi mchog /dkyil 'khor = / nub nas/ zhi ba'i chos ni mchog las byung*/ /ye shes spyod pa rnam sbyong ba/ /kun tu bzang po gsung gi mchog /dkyil 'khor = / byang nas/ sems can kun gyi sems chen po/ /rang bzhin dag cing dri ma med/ /kun bzang thugs mchog kha lo bsgyur/ /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ / zhes so sor lan gsum gsum gsol ba gdab bo/ /gal te gsol ba 'debs pa por 'os pa med na/ bdag nyid kyis brjod pas rung ngo zhes bla ma phyi ma rnams gsung ngo*/ /de nas slob dpon gyi dkyil 'khor 'degs pa'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ hūm̐ badzra u tiṣṭha/ bsgom pa'i dkyil 'khor nam mkhar bzhugs par gyur/ gtso bo las bdag nyid gtso bo zhe sdang gshin rje gshed dpa' bo gcig pa'i rnam pa can de/ dkyil 'khor gyi las la zhugs par gyur/ dbyug thod dam rdo dril lag tu bzung la dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bgyi ba dang bcas pas gnas la/ rang gi mig g.yas su ma las nyi ma/ g.yon du ṭa las zla ba/ mig 'bras hūm̐ las rdo rje bskal ba'i me ltar 'bar bar gyur/ de nas hūm̐ la gzhi bca' byas la/ g.yon brkyang gi rkang stabs dang*/ hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya bcas la/ phrag pa g.yas nas/ g.yon gyi phyogs la gdong bsgyur la/ kro dha drī ṣtī hriḥ rdo rje'i lta zer 'bar bas bgegs rnams bsreg cing bskrad/ yang g.yas su bsgyur la/ kro dha driṣtihrīḥ bsregs pa rnams sos shing byang chub kyi lam la bkod par gyur/ de nas dga' ba yongs gyur gyi 'gros kyis dbang ldan du song la/ gar gyi 'gying rtsal zhing*/ hrīḥṣtīḥ 'am hūṃ brjod bzhin pas rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i 'gros kyis g.yas bskor du bskor ba lan gcig bya zhing*/

spro na de nas rkang stabs bzhi'am brgyad kyang byas nas/ dbang ldan du gnas pas/ bgegs la bka' bsgo ba ni/ lus ngag sems la gnas pa yi/ /bgegs kyi tshogs kun nga la nyon/ /nga ni dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang*/ /bsrung ba'i 'khor lo rab sbyor ba/ /rdo rje gzugs ni 'bar ba yi/ /lus gsum las skyes bsgom par bya/ /gal te kha cig bdag las 'da'/ /'jigs par 'gyur gyi gzhan du min/ / zhes pa tsam mam/ spro na/ sa'i phyogs 'dir gshin rje gshed dmar po'i dkyil 'khor 'bri bar bya yi/ lha dang lha ma yin dang gnod sbyin dang srin po dang yi dwags dang sha za dang*/ brjod byed 'byung po dang mkha' 'gro dang mkha' 'gro ma dang*/ rnon po dang nam mkha' lding dang mi'am ci dang rig sngags grub pa rgan po rgan mo g.yog 'khor dang bcas pa gang dag 'khod pa rnams dengs shig /'di ltar rdo rje 'chang gi bka' thob nas myur ba nyid du dengs shig /gang dag mi 'gro ba de dag ni/ phyag na rdo rje hūṃ zhes bya bas rab tu khros pa'i bzhin 'bar ba can rdo rje 'bar ba kun tu 'bar bas mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par 'gyur ro/ /a pa sa rantu/ suṃ bha dang hrīḥṣtī drag tu bzla zhing*/ rdo rje bsor bas/ yungs kar brab/ gu gul bdug /rol chen bya ste de ltar lan gsum mo/ /'di la rigs lnga'i sgo nas bka' bsgo ba ni mi mdzad pas de tsam gyis chog go /de nas gang yang rung ba'i phur bu la dar dmar po'i cod pan dang*/ yungs kar gyi thum bu btags/ dri bzang byugs/ gu gul bdug /bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ phur bu stod phra dog gshin rje gshed ljang khu zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas dbyug pa dang g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ smad phur bu'i rnam pa can/ 'bar ba'i 'phreng ba 'khrigs par gyur/ rang gi thugs ka nas/ 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes kyi khro bo'i tshogs dpag tu med pa badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ arghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/

phrag dog rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod/ / sogs kyis bstod/ rang gi snying ga nas/ khro bo zhags pa dang lcags kyu thogs pa dpag tu med pa spros/ bgegs rnams kyi mgrin pa zhags pas bcings/ snying ga lcags kyus phub ste/ sdigs bzhin du bkug nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi'i dbang ldan gyi phyogs su hūṃ las byung ba'i 'brub khung zab cing rgya che ba'i nang du bor te/ khro bo rnams rang gi snying gar thim/ oṃ gha gha ghā ta ya gha ta ya/ sarba duṣtaṃ phaṭa/ kī la ya/ kī la ya/ sarba pā paṃ phaṭa/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ badzra kī la ya/ badzra dha ro adzñā pa ya ti/ sarba bi ghnan kā ya waka tsitta badzra kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces sgril shing btab/ bgegs rnams kyi spyi bo nas rkang mthil gyi bar thal byung du phub te/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi la btab pas/ lus g.yo ba med pa/ ngag rlung rgyu ba med pa/ yid rnam par rtog pa dang bral ba/ 'od gsal bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin du gyur/ oṃ badzra rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ lan gsum/ phur bu'i gnas dang dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi'i phyogs thams cad rdo rje'i sa gzhi dang rwa gur rab tu 'bar bas bsrung bar gyur/ smon lam dang shis brjod cung zad bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor gshegs gsol ma byas kyi bar phur bu sgul bskyod mi bya'o/ /de yan chad kyi sdom ni/ gtor ma mchod pa tshar lnga yungs kar dang*/ /ba byung dri bzang gu gul phur pa dang*/ /rdo dril cang te'u nang mchod la sogs bshams/ /sngon 'gro gtor ma mchod pa byin bebs dang*/ /lhan skyes rnal 'byor sa gzhi sbyang ba dang*/ /dkyil 'khor sgom dang mchod bstod gsol ba gdab/ /nam mkhar 'degs dag mig dang rkang byin rlabs/ /bskor ba stang stabs bgegs la bka' bsgo bya/ / phur bu bskyed cing 'debs dang bsrung ba'o/ /de dag gi nub dang po la bya ba sa chog rdzogs/ gnyis pa la/ bdag gi rnal 'byor dang*/ lhag gnas dngos so/

/dang po ni/ 'og tu dgos pa'i yo byad rnams tshang bar byas/ spyi'i mchod pa cha tshang ba zhig bshams/ sngon 'gro gtor ma dang gnas yo byin rlabs sa chog gi skabs ltar mtha' gcig tu dgos pa ma yin kyang*/ skabs 'dir lag len la zhu 'bul mdzad pas/ phyag gsum btsal la maṇḍal bshams/ phyag gsum btsal la me tog bskyed/ /phyag gsum btsal la zhu 'bul bya/ /phyag gsum btsal la me tog bsdu/ /phyag gsum btsal la maṇḍal 'bul/ /phyag gsum btsal la maṇḍal bskul/ /phyag gsum btsal la gral du 'khod/ /ces pa ltar yin pa las/ gzhan rnams lag len mthong ba nyid kyis shes shing*/ gsol gdab ni/ sems can don du sems dge bas/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kun/ /tshul bzhin cho gar ldan pa yi/ /rnal 'byor la ni nyer gnas mdzod/ / ces lan gsum brjod pa'o/ /tshogs pa yod na 'di dag bya ba yin gyis/ gzhan du mi dgos so/ / de nas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed yig brgya'i bsgom bzlas rnams byas la/ nang mchod gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs/ rang skad cig gis gshin rje gshed/

zhes pa nas/ yang dag spong ba bzhi rnam par dag pa'i don to/ / zhes pa'i bar bsgrub thabs yongs su rdzogs par bsgom mo/ /gnyis pa la bzhi las/ dang po sa'i lha mo sta gon ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi'i gnas su/ dri bzang gi thig le la me tog gi tshom bu bkod/ sa lha'i mchod pa dang gtor ma bshams/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa gur me ri dang bcas pa'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lor gyur/ oṃ rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ lag pa g.yas pa sa la reg / rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ sa 'og nas sa'i lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa badzra sa mā dzaḥ tshom bu'i steng du baṃ yig du gyur pa 'khod/ baṃ las sa'i lha mo gser gyi mdog can/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ g.yas dpang por khas len pa'i phyag rgya can/ g.yon gser gyi bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba thugs kar 'dzin pa/ lte ba yan chad sa'i dkyil 'khor nas 'thon pa/ bdag la mngon du phyogs pas bzhugs par gyur/ oṃ pri thwī/ de wī sa pa ri wa ra/ arghaṃ pra tī tstsha na maḥ zhes mchod yon phul nas/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin bzhin du/ oṃ pri thwī de wī zhes pa la/ puṣpe sogs btags te nyer spyod lngas mchod/ gtor ma a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bha wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ a las byung ba'am ka pā la yangs shing rgya che bar/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ oṃ pra thwī de wī sa pa ri wā ra bhyaḥ zhes pa la/ a kā ro btags pa lan gsum gyis phul/ skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par gyi/ /sa dang pha rol phyin rnams la/ /lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur/ /shākya seng ge skyob pa yis/ /ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa/ /de bzhin bdag gis bdud kyi sde/ /bcom par byas te dkyil 'khor 'bri/ / zhes lan gsum brjod/ dkyil 'khor gyi las ci bde bar gyis shig ces brjod cing snang ba thob par bsam/

pri thwā+-i mtshan sngags la arghaṃ nas shapta 'i bar gyis btags pas mchod/ 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod phul/ sa'i lha mo slar yang sa de nyid la thim zhes brjod cing bsam/ sa'i lha mo lhag par gnas pa'o/ / gnyis pa lha sta gon ni/ de nas de ma thag tu sa lha'i tshom bu dang*/ mchod pa rnams bsal la/ skabs 'dir lhag gnas mi 'chol ba'i don du/ las thig yongs rdzogs 'debs pa dang*/ thig chen brgyad tsam 'debs pa dag kyang yod mod/ 'di ni lha nyung ba'i phyir/ lhag gnas mi 'chol bar byed sla zhing*/ 'dir thig 'debs pa la dgos pa gzhan med pa'i phyir/ bshad tshod dang mthun par bya ba nyid legs so/ /des na 'di ltar bya ste/ oṃ āḥhūṃ lan gsum gsum gyis/ gtso bo'i gnas su dri bzang gi thig le gru bzhi dang*/ gzhan 'khor bzhi dang bum pa'i gnas rnams su zlum po re bya'o/ /lha rnams la so so'i rang sngags lan gsum gsum dang*/ bum pa bzhi la 'bru gsum lan gsum gsum gyis tshom bu bkod la/ mtha' bskor du lha grangs las mi nyung ba'i mchod pa dang gtor ma lag len ltar bshams/ a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ sna tshogs padma dang nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje/ zhes pa nas/ zla ba'i gdan/ oṃ hrī ṣtiḥ sogs/ oṃ dāe ṣa rā ti sogs oṃ mo hanta kraṃ ta nas ir ṣya rā ti hūṃ dzaḥ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo/ badzra sa mā dzaḥ arghaṃ nas shapta 'i bar gyis mchod/ tshom bu'i steng du lha rnams bzhugs par gyur pa ni/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du/ bcom ldan 'das zhe sdang gshin rje gshed/ zhes pa nas/ gang bas kha brgyan pa'o/ /rang gi snying ga'i sku las 'od zer 'phros zhes pa nas dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ 'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi zhes pa nas swāhā 'i bar/ sa lha'i skabs ltar mtshams bcing*/ gong bzhin mchod pa bsang sbyangs/

byin gyis brlabs/ mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ rgyas par na dngos gzhi dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i skabs ltar ram/ bsdus par na/ phyi mchod/ rgyal srid sna bdun/ nang mchod/ bstod pa rnams sgrub thabs su bshad pa ltar byas la/ gtor ma bsangs sbyangs byin rlabs kyang sgrub thabs bzhin/ rang gi snying ga nas/ khro bo zhes pa nas/ phyogs skyong rnams bshegs su gsol ba 'i bar yang sgrub thabs ltar ro/ /de nas spos snod dang bcas pa'i rdor dril thogs te/ gshin rje gshed rdor bcom ldan 'das/ /rig sngags rgyal mchog khyod la 'dud/ /slob ma rnams la brtse ba dang*/ khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir/ / mgon po thugs rje'i bdag nyid can/ /dkyil 'khor bdag ni bri bar 'tshal/ / de phyir bcom ldan bdag gus la/ /bka' drin gnang bar mdzad pa'i rigs/ / sangs rgyas 'gro 'khor bya don stsol/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'bras gnas dang*/ /gzhan yang gang dag gsang sngags lha/ /lha dang 'jig rten skyong ba dang*/ /'byung po byang chub gtan gnas dang*/ /sems can bstan la mngon dga' ba/ /gang su rdo rje'i spyan ldan rnams/ /bdag la yang dag dgongs su gsol/ /rdo rje 'chang chen che ge bdag /gshin rje gshed dmar dkyil 'khor ni/ /ji ltar nus par nyer sbyor bas/ /'gro ba sbyang phyir bri bar bgyid/ /de bdag slob mar bcas pa la/ /rjes su brtse bas nyer bzung nas/ /tshogs pa thams cad dkyil 'khor du/ /nye bar gnas pa mdzad par rigs/ / zhes lan gsum gsol bas gnang ba thob par yang gsal/ rdo rje shugs kyi phyag rgya dang bcas/ oṃ badzra u tiṣṭha zhes dkyil 'khor nam mkha' la bteg /yang na phyis kyi lag len ltar/ bum pa lhag gnas dang*/ slob ma lhag gnas grub nas/ mchod pa kha gsos/ bsang sbyangs byin rlabs mchod bstod rnams byas nas nam mkhar btegs kyang rung*/ gang ltar yang nam mkha' btegs ma thag / arghaṃ nas/ shapta 'i bar gyis mchod/ 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod phul/

gti mug rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod/ / zhes pa nas/ dkyil 'khor dbang phyug khyod phyag 'tshal/ / zhes bstod/ bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed po'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ ji srid spyan ma drangs kyi bar du mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas 'dir bzhugs la/ bdag cag slob mar bcas pa'i bar chad bsrung zhing*/ slad nas dkyil 'khor byin gyis brlabs pa dang*/ sems can thams cad la dngos grub dam pa stsal du gsol/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi nas swāhā sa mtshams bcing ngo*/ / dkyil 'khor lhag par gnas pa'o/ / gsum pa bum pa sta gon ni/ de nas bum pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa drug /gnyis kha dog dkar por bsgyur ras bzang pos mgrin pa dkri/ hrīḥṣtīḥ bzlas pa'i yungs kar gyis brab cing gu gul gyis bdug thams cad la mtshan ma ni/ pad nyi la gnas pa'i dbyug pa 'od zer 'phro ba kho na 'god do/ /de rnams chu gtsang mas bgang*/ gser/ dngul/ byu ru/ mu men/ mu tig te rin chen lnga/ kandha ka ri/ dbang lag /sle tres/ rgya mtsho lbu ba/ shu dag dkar po ste sman lnga/ gur gum/ tsan dan dkar dmar/ dza ti/ ga bur ste dri lnga/ nas gro sran ma/ 'bras/ til dkar ste 'bru lnga/ 'o ma/ mar/ sbrang rtsi/ bu ram/ lan tshwa ste snying po lnga/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga ste bum rdzas sum/ cung zad snga blug / shing bzang po'i yal gas kha brgyan/ stegs bu gang yang rung ba la/ g.yas su dbang gi bum pa lnga po lnga tshom dang*/ g.yon du las bum bkod/ /mdun du mchod pa dang*/ gtso bum gyi steng du dang chos spos chus nang bkang gzung thag rdo rje dang bcas pa/ bkod bsangs dang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ paṃ las padma dang*/ a las zla ba'i steng du baṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i bum pa lto ba ldir zhing mgrin pa phra ba/ kha g.yel ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha'i gos kyi mgul ba bcing ba/ dpag bsam gyi shing gi kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud thams cad kyis yongs su gang ba'i/

bum pa rnams kyi nang du/ padma dang nyi ma'i gdan re re/ de yang dbus su/ ya las zhe sdang gshin rje gshed sku mdog dmar po/ dpa' bo nyi ma bye ba'i 'od dang mtshungs pa'i gzi brjid kyi phung po 'bar ba la yum rdo rje ro langs ma dmar mos 'khyud pa/ shar du kṣe las gti mug gshin rje gshed dkar po dang las bum gyi nang yum tsārtsi ka nag mos 'khyud pa/ lho ru ma las ser sna gshin rje gshed ser po la yum phag mo ser mos 'khyud pa/ nub tu me las 'dod chags gshin rje gshed dmar po la yum dbyangs can ma dkar mos 'khyud pa/ byang du de las phra dog gshin rje gshed ljang khu la yum gau rī ljang mos 'khyud pa/ dpa' bo nas/ bzhugs pa'o/ /gtso bo'i mtshams bzhir pad zla la/ shar lhor mu men/ nas/ kha brgyan pa'o/ / bum pa gnyis las med na rnam rgyal bum pa'i nang du padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba dang*/ phyogs kyi 'dab ma bzhi la nyi ma'i gdan re re dbus su ya las sogs gong dang 'dra bzhugs pa'o/ / mtshams kyi 'dab ma zhi la nas/ kha brgyan pa'o/ / zhes brjod/ lha de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ rang gi snying ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ rdo rje 'dzin pa/ nas/ dza hūṃ baṃ hoḥ 'i bar bdag skyed kyi skabs bzhin/ gzungs thag nas bzung*/ rang gi snying ga nas sngags kyi 'phreng ba gzungs thag la 'khril nas song bas/ lha rnams kyis thugs kar phog /thugs rgyud bskul bas sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs te bum pa rnams gang bar gyur/ so so'i sngags brgya rtsa re dang*/ hrīḥṣtī lhag par mang bar bzla'o/ /las bum la hrīḥṣtī gang 'os dang hūṃ bdun bzlas la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūṃ/ zhes pa'ang lan bdun las mi nyung ba bzla/ mchod pa byin rlabs gong bzhin/ arghaṃ nas shapta 'i bar gyis mchod/ so so'i snying po'i mthar 'bru gsum btags pas nang mchod 'bul/

gti mug rdo rje sogs kyis bstod/ bdag cag slob mar bcas pa la dngos grub ma lus pa bstsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ las bum gyi chu ku shas blangs te/ bum pa rnams la skor zhing*/ gnas dang yo byad sogs la gtor/ ji srid dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du bar du gcod pa thams cad bsrung bar mdzod cig / yig brgya lan gsum gyi mthar/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs/ oṃ āḥhūṃ zhes dung chos kyi chu bum pa so sor blug /mchod yon phul ba'i rkyen gyis bum nang gi lha rnams byang chub kyi sems bde ba chen po'i ngo bor zhugs/ bum pa'i chu dang ro gcig tu gyur/ las bum gyi lha mi zhu ba'i lugs kyang yod mod kyi/ dkyus ltar bya'o/ /bum pa lhag par gnas pa'o/ / gsum pa slob ma sta gon ni/ de yang nyi ma de nyid kyi sang nub kho na dngos gzhi'i dbang bskur byed na/ 'dir slob ma lhag gnas bya la/ nyi ma gzhan dang gzhan la dbang bskur byed pa'i tshe/ dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i rjes su slob ma lhag gnas bya ba 'thad pa yin no/ /de yang 'di ltar/ dkyil 'khor khang pa'i phyi rol lam/ gsang ba'i yo byad rnams sbas nas/ dkyil 'khor khang pa de nyid du'ang rung ste/ slob ma rnams khrus byas/ phyag dang maṇḍal phul ba la/ 'di ltar/ sems bskyed nang dbang gsol btab spro ba bskyed/ /rgyun bshags byin rlabs mchod pa so shing dang*/ /'khyor chu bsrung skud chos bshad ku sha sbyin/ /rmi lam brtag dang sdom pa bzung ba'o/ /dang po ni/ rang gi bslab ldan 'khor bzhi po/ /theg chen blo can rnams la ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs pa yi/ /cho ga yang dag rjes su gnang*/ /sngags kyi dngos grub don gnyer gang*/ /dkyil 'khor 'dir ni 'jug par 'gyur/ / bsod nams 'dod pas de las gzhan/ /gzhan dag 'jig rten pha rol gnyer/ /blo bzang phal cher dad byas nas/ /'jig rten pha rol don gnyer 'jug /gal te 'di 'bras don gnyer na/

/'jig rten pha rol 'grub mi 'gyur/ /'jig rten pha rol la dmigs na/ /'bad pa med par 'di 'bras 'grub/ /de phyir 'jig rten pha rol gyi/ /don du yid ni brtan par gyis/ / zhes don bshad/ de nas slob dpon gyi thugs kha'i 'od kyis slob ma rnams bkug te zhal du bcug /sku'i lam brgyud rdo rje'i lam nas mkhar babs pas lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma mtha' dag dag ste/ gtso bo zhe sdang gshin rje gshed kyi skur gyur pa la/ yang slob dpon gyi thugs kha'i 'od kyis spyan drangs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs rnams yab kyi zhal du bcug /thugs kar byang chub sems su gyur te/ rdo rje'i lam nas byung ba'i byang chub kyi sems kyi dbang bskur byin gyis brlabs/ hūṃ zhes bya bas gsang ba nas phyir spros te/ rang gi stan la 'khod par gyur/ de nas gsol ba gdab pa ni/ mā ma kī dang lhan cig sbyor/ /bdag gi ston pa dgyes chen khyod/ /byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa/ / mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol/ /byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon pos bdag ni bzhugs su gsol/ / zhes lan gsum rjes bzlos bya'o/ / de nas spro ba bskyed pa ni/ bu tshur shog cig theg chen po'i/ /gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga mchog /khyod la yang dag bstan par bya/ khyod ni tshul chen snod yin no/ / sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje can/ /dus gsum 'byung ba'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /rdo rje sngags kyis mthu yis ni/ /ye shes mnyam med yang dag brnyes/ /gsang sngags sbyor ba mnyam med pa/ /gang gis shākya seng ge sogs/ / mchog rnams kyis ni bdud kyi sde/ /mi bzad chen po stobs chen bcom/ / 'jig rten rjes 'jug rtogs nas ni/ / 'khor lo bskor nas mya ngan 'das/

/ de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir/ /bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig / ces brjod la don bshad/ sgrub thabs ltar rgyun bshags bya ba'am/ yang na/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs 'chi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*/ /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung*/ / lan gsum gyis thun mong gi sdom pa bzung*/ hrīḥṣtī lan gsum gyis bgegs bskrad cing bsrung ba bya/ slob ma'i snying khar hūṃ las rdo rje dang*/ mgrin par a las padma dang*/ spyi bor oṃ las 'khor lo rnams gnas pa la/ slob dpon gyi dri bzang dang bdud rtsi sbyar bas thig le byas pa na/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs dang*/ gsung dang*/ sku rdo rje'i ngo bo hūṃ āḥ.oṃ rnams byung zhing slar yang dpral ba nas mar reg pas/ lus ngag yid gsum rdo rje gsum gyi rang bzhin du brtan par mos shig byas la/ slob ma'i gnas gsum du dri bzang gi thig le bya'o/ /de nas snying gar dri chab/ mgo bor me tog mdun du spos dang*/ mar me rnams sbyin pas mchod/ so shing bsangs sbyangs/

stong pa'i ngang las/ hūṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i so shing du gyur/ hrīḥ ṣtī bzlas shing slob ma'i lag tu gtad/ oṃ badzra ha sa ha zhes so shing gi rwa bar 'dor du bcug / ltas dang mthun pa'i dngos grub lung ston/ stong pa'i ngang las/ shaṃ las byung ba'i dung phor gyi dbus su/ baṃ las byung ba'i 'khyor chu nus pa thams cad dang ldan par gyur/ 'khyil ba'i sngags lan bdun bzlas te/ oṃ hrīḥbi shuddha dharmā sarba pā paṃ ni tsa a sya sho dha ya sarba bi kalpan a pa na ya hūṃ/ zhes 'khyor ba lan gsum bkang shing sbyin/ stong pa'i ngang las/ hūṃ las dang dhi las byung ba'i ku sha'i stan dang*/ sngas su gyur/ oṃ badzra tikṣ+ṇa baṃ/ zhes byin/ stong pa'i ngang las/ hūṃ las byung ba'i bsrung skud dmar por gyur/ dpung pa g.yon par bcings nas/ oṃ buddha mai tri rakṣa rakṣa sarbaṃ swā hā/ zhes brtan par bya/ de nas zab mo'i chos bshad pa ni/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen dag /res 'ga' 'byung ngam mi 'byung srid/ / u dum wa ra'i me tog ltar/ /rgya lam na ni res 'ga' 'byung*/ /gsang sngags spyod tshul 'byung ba ni/ /de bas kyang ni shin tu dkon/ /gang gis sems can mnyam med don/ /mya ngan mi 'da' byed par nus/ /bskal ba bye ba du mar ni/ / sngon du sdig pa byas pa dag /dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra mthong ma thag /de dag zad par 'gyur yin na/ /grags pa mtha' yas sngags spyod pa'i/ /tshul la gnas na smos ci dgos/ /skyob pa'i gsang sngags bzlas na ni/ /go 'phang bla na med par 'gyur/ /spyod mchog 'di la gang rnams ni/ /blo gros shin tu mi g.yo na/ /de rnams kyi ni sdug bsngal kun/ /'byung ba'i ngan 'gro yang dag bcad/ /bdag nyid chen po khyed rnams kyis/ /rnyed pa mnyam med de ring brnyes/ /gang phyir rgyal ba sras bcas pa/ /bdag nyid chen po khyed rnams kyi/ /bstan pa 'di la khyed cag kun/ /yongs su bzung ste skye bzhin pa/

/de yis khyed rnams theg chen las/ /legs pa nyid du bskyed par 'gyur/ /theg pa chen po cher 'byung ba'i/ / lam mchog 'di ni dpal dang ldan/ /gang la khyed rnams 'gro 'gyur ba/ /de bzhin gshegs par 'gyur ba yin/ / zhes brjod cing don bshad do/ /de nas/ rmi lam brtag cing ngan na bsrung ba ni/ bu kyai sang ni dkyil 'khor mchog /mthong bar 'gyur ro nyol zhig dang*/ /rmi lam mthong ba gang yin pa/ /de kun nga la legs par smros/ / zhes brjod la de'i don bshad cing*/ ku sha'i gdan la dge ba'i sems dang bcas seng ge'i nyal stabs kyis nyol cig / ces kyang brjod/ de nas nangs par slob dpon gyi sdom pa bzung ba'i phyir/ slar yang maṇḍal phul te/ 'khor lo phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang*/ /dam pa bdag la bstsal nas kyang*/ /mgon po 'khor lo lha dag gis/ /de nyid slob dpon 'phrin las dang*/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi dam tshig dang*/ /sdom pa gsang mchog rtag tu ni/ /sems can kun gyi don bgyid phyir/ / slob dpon bdag 'gyur bshad du gsol/ / zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab/ spro na dri ba dril lan sogs kyang bya ba yin mod kyi/ gzhung na mi gsal ba'i phyir mi dgos la/ sdom pa bsgrags pa ni don gyi dgos pa ltar snang yang*/ lugs 'dir mi 'byung ba ni/ sdom pa bsgrags pa'i tshigs bcad mi brjod par de'i don slob dpon gyis 'chad pa'i dbang du byas pa'o/ /de ltar na/ rigs lnga'i de dam tshig bcu bzhi sogs ci rigs pa zhig slob dpon gyis bshad la/ de rnams bzung snyam pas 'di'i rjes bzlos gyis zhes brda sprad la sdom pa bzung ba'i tshig ni sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub kyi snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i/ /byang chub sems ni bla na med/

/dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /tshul khrims kyis ni bslab pa dang*/ /dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*/ / sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum/ /so sor brtan por bzung bar bgyi/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun ste/ /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor las skyes pa'i/ /sdom pa deng nas brtan por bzung*/ /rdo rje'i rigs mchog chen po la/ / rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang*/ /yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi/ /slob dpon dag kyang bzung bar bgyi/ /rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ /nyin re bzhin yang dus drug tu/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /byang chub chen po las byung ba'i/ / padma'i rigs chen dag pa la/ /phyi dang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos ni ma lus bzung*/ /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi/ /byang chub sems ni bla med mchog /dam pa bdag gi bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag gis sdom pa ma lus bzung*/ / ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral/ /ma sgrol ba rnams bdag gis sgrol/ / dbugs ma phyung ba dbugs phyung zhing*/ /sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god/ / ces lan gsum rjes zlos byar gzhug /des sta gon gyi chos rnams legs par tshar ba yin zhes brda sprad nas/ dge ba bsngo/ slob ma rnams rang gnas su btang*/ 'di la dpal 'dzin gyi dkyil chog las ni/ slob ma lhag gnas nub gnyis pa'i cho ga'i skabs 'dir ma gsungs te/ dkyil 'khor bris zin pa'i 'og tu byas na 'jug pa bde ba la dgongs so/ /'on kyang phyi rabs kyi bla ma rnams dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga spyi dang mthun par 'chad pa bzhin bkod do/ / gsum pa la dkyil 'khor bri ba dang*/ sgrub cing mchod pa dang*/ bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba gsum las slob ma bzhug cing dbang bskur ba ste/

bzhi las/ dang po la/ thig skud byin rlabs thig gdab pa/ rdul tshon byin rlabs/ rdul tshon dgye ba/ rgyan bsgram pa ste bzhi las/ dang po ni/ nangs par snga bar langs nas sngon 'gro gtor ma nas/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa gong bzhin byas la/ ras bal gyi srad bu kha dog sna lnga'am/ lnga la nyi shu rtsa lnga rkyang la mchod pa bshams/ 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ srad bu sngon po ya las zhe sdang gshin rje gshed/ dkar po kṣe las gti mug gshin rje gshed/ ser po ma las ser sna gshin rje gshed/ dmar po me las 'dod chags gshin rje gshed/ ljang khu da las phra dog gshin rje gshed/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig nas/ nyams dgu dang ldan pa'o/ / thams cad rang snang gi yum dang bcas par bskyed pa'am/ sgrub thabs bzhin bskyed kyang rung bar mngon no/ / dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ rang gi snying ga nas spros pa'i dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ oṃ badzri bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ zhes dbang bskur/ dbang gi lha rnams dam tshig pa de rnams la thim/ dza hūṃ baṃ hoḥ arghaṃ nas/ shapta 'i bar gyis mchod/ gti mug rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod/ / sogs kyis bstod pa'i srol yod kyang de nyid lnga pas bstod na legs pas/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /rdo rje dbyings ni mkhas pa che/ /rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum/ /gsang ba'i dbyings la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rnam par snang mdzad dag pa che/ /rdo rje zhi ba dga' ba che/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal mchog gi mchog /ston pa rdo rje phyag 'tshal lo/ /rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab/ /rdo rje nam mkha' dri ma med/ /rang bzhin dag pa gos pa med/ /rdo rje sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje dpag med rgyal po che/ /mi rtog nam mkha' rdo rje 'dzin/ /'dod chags pha rol phyin pa brnyes/ /rdo rje gsung la phyag 'tshal lo/ / don yod rgyal po rdzogs sangs rgyas/

/bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa/ / dag pa ngo bo nyid las byung*/ /rdo rje sems dpa' phyag 'tshal bstod/ / ces pas bstod/ gshin rje gshed rigs lnga zhu ba las byung ba'i thig skud lngar gyur/ bsdu na/ sa bon lnga las byung ba'i thig skud lnga rigs lnga'i ngo bor mos pa tsam gyis chog /'dir lugs rnying 'ga' las lha lnga'i lugs la/ spyi dang mthun par rigs lnga dngos bskyed pa ltar/ legs par yang mngon cing*/ sgrub thabs su gtso bo'i sa bon hūṃ nyid rigs kun la sbyar ba de ltar yang gtso bo rgyal ba gcig pu nyid/ /lnga yis tshul du rnam par gnas/ /zhes pa dang mtshungs pas te/ 'dir yang ya sogs 'khor lo'i skabs las gzhan na ma gsungs pas/ gshin rje gshed rigs lnga bskyed na yang*/ sa bon hūṃ ngaṃ*/ hūṃ sogs lnga las skyed na legs par kho bo sems mo/ /'on kyang bla ma rnams mi mdzad pas dkyus bzhin bya ste/ bum bskyed dang*/ rdul tshon dang*/ dbang lnga la'ang rig pa mtshungs so/ / rang gi mig gnyis su dza las byung ba'i nyi ma dang zla ba/ mig 'bras hūṃ du gyur/ 'bar ba'i lta stangs dang bcas pas rdzi ma sdeb cing*/ oṃ dapti dṛṣti aṅku sha dzaḥ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas/ ye shes kyi srad bu'i tshogs rnams spyan drangs/ dam tshig gi srad bu la thim/ oṃ āḥpra yatstsha dwe ṣa kā la a ri swa tsakra sū tra na ya hūṃ/ de bzhin du dwe ṣa'i gnas su/ mo ha dang*/ pi shu nā dang*/ rā ga dang*/ iṣya zhes pa rnams bcug la lan gsum gsum bzlas pas gsol ba btab te/ las kyi rdo rje phra dog gshin rje gshed kyi nga brgyal bzung ba dang lhan cig thig skud sgril bzhin du/ oṃ a no n+ya/ a nu ga ta/ sarba dharmā pa raspa ra/ a nu pra bṛṣta/ sarba dharmā aryanta na/ a nu pra bṛṣta sarba dharmā hūṃ/ zhes ci nus su brjod do/ /de nas dri bzang gis byugs/ rin po che'i snod du bzhag ste/

arghaṃ la sogs sa mchod/ hrīḥṣtī bzlas te bsrung ba bya'o/ / gnyis pa ni/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyis gzhi dris byugs/ me tog sil ma bkram/ nam mkha'i dbyings su dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad bzhugs par gyur/ rdo rje dang bcas pa'i lag pas thig sna phyogs shig lte ba'i thad du bzung nas/ slob dpon bden bral du gnas nas/ dbang ldan du phyogs pa dang*/ slob ma dbang ldan nas bden bral du phyogs pas gnas pa las/ dzdza dzdza dzdza/ zhes gnyis kas brjod bzhin du thig sna gtod cing len/ de nas slob dpon nub dang*/ slob ma shar du gnas pas/ oṃ āḥbadzra sa ma ya sū traṃ ma ti kra ma hūṃ/ sems can don la khyod rnams kyi/ dus yin de phyir 'dir byon cig / ces pa dang*/ thig gi sgras/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams bskul nas/ thig la thim/ ces dang por nam mkha' dang*/ de nas sa la gdab bo/ /rim pa de nyid kyis thig chen brgyad po gdab pa yin te/ de yang 'di skad ces bya ste/ nub shar lho byang me dbang ldan/ /rlung srin drung dbang me srin po/ /g.yas bskor rgyab 'gros tshangs logs gdab/ /me rlung srin po dbang ldan nas/ /rgyab 'gros spang ste zur thig gdab/ /gnyis sdeb dang po slob dpon dang*/ /phyi ma slob ma'i gnas su shes/ /de dag la/ thig chen brgyad ni/ re re bzhin nam mkha' la lan gsum dang*/ sa la lan gsum gdab/ 'di'i logs thig ni/ rtsa thig gi yin la/ rtsa thig gi phyi rol gyi thig drug po rnams 'debs par spro na/ nam mkha' la gdab mi dgos pas 'og tu gdab pa gsum gyis chog go /de nas thig skud de nyid kyis las thig gdab par bya ba yin la/ de yang 'di ltar/ dbus su mtshan ma legs btab nas/ shar nub tshangs thig drang por btab/ zlum bskor gsum gyi nya ru 'gyur/ /nya steng tshangs thig gnyis pa btab/ /lho dang byang du zlum por bskor/

/bya rjes steng nas zur thig btab/ /zur thig steng nas bya rjes bzhi/ /de la phyi yi thig bzhi btab/ /logs gtub gsum gyi bya rog rjes/ / mnan pas cha chen bcu drug 'gyur/ /phyi rgyu cha chen re re mnan/ /dang po gnyis pa bdun pa dang*/ / dgu pa rnams ni bzhi bzhir bgo /gsum pa'i nang du cha phran gcig /bzhi pa rang sar bzhag par bya/ /lnga pa dbus dor mtha' gnyis gdab/ /drug pa phyed gdab phyi ma gdab/ /brgyad pa'i dbus su cha phran gcig /tshangs thig zur thig ma gtogs pa/ /de rnams skam thig gdab par bya/ /dbus su phur bu btsugs nas ni/ /bzhi lnga bcu pa'i thig steng dang*/ /bcu nang cha chung phyed tsam bskor/ / 'dab thig lag len bzhin du gdab/ /bcu cig rtsa ba'i thig yin te/ /thig chen brgyad kyi logs thig go /bcu bdun pa ni zla yab thig /rtsa ba'i thig las phyi rol tu/ /zur nas dngos su thig lnga las/ /dang po gnyis ni gsum par reg /de gnyis cha chung gnyis kyis sbrel/ /gsum pa bzhi pa lnga ba rnams/ /brgyad pa'i thig la reg par gdab/ /rtsa ba'i phyi nas gnyis pa'i thig /bcu bzhi pa yi bar du'o/ /de nas dngos su bzhi pa'i bar/ /steng du bco lnga pa la reg go /nang du bcu gsum la reg pa'i/ /ngos su rim pas thig bzhi ni/ /dang po bcu drug pa la reg /rtse nas rtse ru bcu drug pa/ / gzhan gsum bcu bdun pa la reg /tshangs dang nyer gcig 'dzoms sa nas/ /cha chen gcig gis bskor ba ni/ /g.yas g.yon logs su bzhi par reg /bcu dgu bzhi pa 'dzoms sa nas/ /snga ma'i sne nas bcu bdun bar/ /cha chung gnyis kyis bskor bar bya/ /de nang cha chung phyed kyis bskor/ /glang rgyab mig gsum bskor lugs yin/ /gal te skyog po byed 'dod na/ /mda' yab thig gi phyi ngos su/ /dang po'i thig nang phyed dang drug /gnyis pa gsum pa drug drug go /bzhi pa la ni bzhi yin ste/ /lnga pa la ni phyed dang bzhi/ /drug pa gsum nas gcad par bya/

/bdun pa tshangs dang 'phrad mtshams bcad/ /de rnams nang du'ang phyer re'o/ /rta babs snam bu bcu gcig ni/ /gur nas gsungs par kho bo smra/ /bco brgyad la sogs thig bzhi ni/ /dgu pa nas bzung glang rgyab bar/ /rtse mo cha chung gsum du sbrel/ /de 'og brgyad pa cha chung gcig /nyer gnyis pa dang nyer gsum pa/ / brgyad pa nas bzung bskor thig bar/ /nyer bzhi la sogs bzhi po ni/ /bdun pa nas ni bdun pa'i bar/ /nyer brgyad lnga nas lnga pa'i bar/ /de 'og lnga pa cha chung gcig /nyer bzhi la sogs bzhi po ni/ /bdun pa'i thig nas gcad par bya/ /de 'og drug pa'o nyer gnyis dang*/ /nyer gsum brgyad pa sbrel ba yin/ /de 'og bdun pa'i thig tu bcad/ /nyer brgyad pa yi phyi ngos su/ /gnyis pa'i thig las mthon pa yi/ /cha chung bzhi pa byin gyis phra/ /rtse mo ral gri'i dbyibs su bya/ /brang ngos cha chung gnyis kyi tshad/ /nyer gnyis pa dang gnyis 'dzoms par/ /cha chung brgyad kyi thig skud kyi/ /bcu bdun pa yi thig nas ni/ /dbus rwa'i thig la reg par bskor/ /de yi phyi rol cha chung gcig

/ bskor te rwa yi nang thig go /nyer gnyis nyer gsum bar gyi ni/ /bzhi pa'i steng nas cha chung dgus/ /sngar bzhin bskor ba phyi thig go /thig skud nyis ltab byas nas ni/ /dbus kyi phur bu la dkon te/ /rta babs mda' yab rtse mo'i tshad/ /dbang ldan mtshams nas g.yas su bskor/ khyams su 'gyur zhing phyi nas slar/ /cha chen gcig dang cha chen phyed/ /slar yang cha chen gcig gis bskor/ / phyogs kun mnyam pa nyid du mos/ /de nas skam thig rnams dbyi bar bya'o/ /'di la dur khrod 'bri ba'i srol ni med la ka ma lakṣi tas nag po la bshad pa ltar 'dir yang legs par 'gyur ro/ /gal te thig thung la mos na/ zur thig gi rjes su/ dkyil 'khor gyi tshad dang mtshungs pa'i rtsa thig btab nas/ phyi rol tu thig drug dang*/ ngos su thig bdun btab/ de nas byar rjes btsal la rta babs kyi thig logs su btab bo/ /de'i rjes su bskor thig rnams bya ste/ 'di la mda' yab kyi thig dang por 'debs pa ni gang nas kyang ma bshad do/ /de nas skam pa'i phyag rgyas dbus kyi phur bu phyung*/ ye shes pa lag gi rdo rje la thim par yid kyis mos/ thig skud la mchod bstod byas la ye shes pa gshegs su gsol ba gtsang sar bzhag go /de nas rdo rje shugs kyi 'jug pas nang du zhugs la/ mig gnyis la hi las byung ba'i nyi ma dang zla ba/ mig 'bras hūṃ las khro bo'i rdo rjer gyur/ khro bo'i lta bas thar pa'i sgo'i bar chad bgegs rnams bcom par gyur/ thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i sgo'i gegs thams cad gsal bar bgyi'o/ / sgo'i rtsa thig dbyi'o/ / gsum pa ni/ rdul tshon sna lnga'am/ lnga lnga nyi shu rtsa lnga lag len bzhin bshams la/ yakṣe ma me da rnams bris/ gong gi thig skud brkyang zhing sgril ba'i sngags dor la thig skud kyi gnas su rdul tshon zhes 'don pa spos/ rdul tshon mtheb srin gyis mnye bzhin du/ oṃ badzra tsi tra sa ma ya ma ti kra ma hūṃ/

zhes lan bdun bdun gyis byin gyis brlabs/ bden pa gang gis sems can rnams/ rdul mang zhing sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams chags pa dang rjes su chags pa'i bden pa des rdul tshon rnams 'bar bar gyur cig /hīḥhīḥhīḥ zhes bzlas shing sbar ro/ / bzhi pa ni/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi nub phyogs nas rdo rje shugs kyi phyag rgya spyi bor bzlog ste/ oṃ badzra be ga a kra ma hoḥ zhes rdo rje shugs kyi 'jug pas nang du zhugs la/ slob dpon gyis dang por phur khung bgang bar bya ste/ dril bu dkrol zhing dkur bsten la/ /dkar ser dmar ljang sngo ba'i rim pas bkang*/ /de nas 'di ni chos dbyings dag pa ste/ /sems can khams ni rab sgrol byed/ /'jam dbyangs rgyal po rang nyid ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyis gnas/ /nyes pa kun las rnams grol ba/ /'khor lo'i nang du yang dag gnas/ / zhes brjod cing dril bu dkrol la/ mthar g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis/ dbang ldan gyi mtshams su sgo tshad gcig gi bar du rtsig pa rim pa lnga bri bar bya'o/ /de nas slob ma rnams kyis ci bde bar tshon dgye bar bya ste/ kha dog dang bkra shis kyis bum pa brgyad sogs mtshan ma thams cad/ dkyil 'khor spyi dang 'dra bar shes pa/ khyad par ngo bo ni/ dbus kyi sna tshogs padma/ phyogs bzhi dmar la me rlung ser/ /bden bral ljang la dbang ldan sngo/ /zhes pa ltar dang*/ glang rgyab kyi nang phyogs mdog dang*/ mda' yab dang*/ spu shu zhes mi 'dod par/ shar bu dang mda' yab tu 'dod cing*/ mda' yab dang padma phyed pa'am/ mchod rten gyi dbyibs so/ /sna tshogs rdo rje phyogs mdog nyid bya'o/ /lugs 'di'i 'gyur byed dam pa dpyal rgyan dā nā shī la glo bo lo tsā ba te bzhi po de thams cad thun mong gi cho ga rnams dpal 'jigs med 'byung gnas kyi rjes su 'brang ba yin cing*/ khyad par chag gis ni/ deng sang phal cher rang rigs rgan po'i ngag

/gtsor 'dzin legs bshad mi 'dzin gnyis skyes 'dra/ /de'i phyir bde chen lam bzang 'jigs med gzhung*/ /rgyud pa'i gdams pas brgyan pa 'ga' la gnang*/ /zhes 'phags yul gyi mkhas grub mtha' yas pa la grags pa'i gzhung bzang po rdo rje 'phreng ba sogs dang mi mthun na/ bod rgan po 'ga' dang mthun yang snying po med par bzhed pas/ chag gi rjes su 'brang bar khas len bzhin du bod rnying pa'i lugs gzhan dang 'bad pas bsre bar mi bya ste/ nags la gnas pa'i spre'u dag / ljon pa'i shing la mi gtsang mthor/ /zhes pa dang mtshungs par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /lha'i mtshan ma la rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan gyis mtshan pa'i dbyug par 'dod pa ni/ rgya gar ba gzhan dang*/ bod kyi gshed dmar ba phyi ma kha cig dang mthun srid kyang*/ lugs 'di la ma yin te/ gong du smos pa'i lo tsā ba chag sogs gsum dang ye mi mthun cing*/ birba pa dang*/ dpal 'dzin gyi lugs gnyis ka las phyir phyogs par 'gyur bas gyi nar spyod pa'o/ /'on te dpyal pa rnams bdag bskyed la phyag mtshan de bzhin 'dod pas rung ngo snyam na ma yin te/ dpyal lugs la ni bdag bskyed pa yang sgo bsrung 'dod pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor 'dri ba'i mtshan ma rnams bcu gsum ma ji lta ba bzhin 'god pa'i phyir ro/ /de la kha cig lha mtshan mi nor ba'i phyir de ltar 'god pa yin no zhes skyon spong ngo*/ /bum pa la ni nor ba'i gnas kyang yod cing*/ mtshan ma btab pas len 'jog /sol bas mi nor ba'i dgos pa yang yod pas 'debs pa yin mod/ 'di la ni de gnyis ka med la/ med kyang dgos na ni/ ka ba dang*/ rta babs la sogs la yang mi nor ba'i mtshan ma dgos par 'gyur ro/ / des na gzhan dang mi mthun zhing rang nyid 'gal ba de spangs la/ padma'i lte ba dang phyogs kyi 'dab ma rnams la/ nyi ma'i gdan gyi steng du/ gtso bo'i mtshan ma ji lta ba'i dbyug pa re bris la/ mtha' me 'od 'bar ba'i nang rigs dang mthun pa'i kha dog shas che ba 'od zer sna lnga 'phro ba bri bar bya'o/

/mu khyud bzhi dmar po la rdo rje sngon po'i phreng ba bri/ bum pa'i kha dog sogs ni sgrub thabs bzhin no/ /tshon bkra brtag pa spro na spyi dang 'dra bar bya/ mthar dkyil 'khor bris zin pa na/ tshon gyi lhag ma rnams bsdus te/ mchod bstod byas la/ ye shes pa nam mkha'i lha'i thugs khar gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdus te bzhag go / lnga pa ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi mtha' kun tu dri bzang gis byugs/ me tog sil ma sogs mchod rdzas dang*/ rgyan thams cad bkram/ rnam rgyal bum pa gtso bo'i gnas su bzhag par mos nas shar sgo'i g.yas su bzhag /bum pa gzhan bzhi phyogs bzhir bkod/ las bum dbang ldan mtshams su bzhag go /mchod pa'i bum pa dang gos zung dang*/ lha re re la mchod rdzas bcu las mi nyung ba rnams so sor bshams la/ oṃ badzra spha ra ṇa khaṃ/ zhes yang yang brjod do/ /gzhan yang yo byad thams cad tshogs par bya ste/ de rnams lag len mthong ba tsam gyis shes par 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa sgrub cing mchod pa ni/ gzhung las ji skad 'byung ba ltar/ snga dro bdag bskyed legs par byas pa'i rjes su/ thig skud byin brlabs nas/ rgyan bgram pa'i bar nyi ma de nyid la grub cing*/ bre mo'i gtam la sogs pa bya ba gzhan gyis bar ma chod par yid yang dag pa'i don la/ rnal du gnas bzhin pas de'i rjes thogs nyid la dkyil 'khor sgrub pa yin na/ sngar gyi bdag bskyed kyi nga rgyal la gnas pa kho nas chog gis/ bdag bskyed bskyar nas len mi dgos pas/ 'dir dkyil 'khor sgrub thabs kho na la zhugs pas chog go /phyis kyi lag len ltar lhag gnas kyi mthar thig tshon byin rlabs/ thig 'debs par byed pa dang*/ gzhan yang nyi ma de nyid la dkyil 'khor bris ma zin na/ sngon 'gro gtor ma nas/ dag pa dran pa yan chad/ sta gon ltar byas nas/ mdun bskyed sgrub pa yin te/ rdo rje shugs kyi 'jug pas zhugs par mos la oṃ badzra be ga a kra ma hūṃ/

bdag nyid dkyil 'khor gi nang shar gyi lha snam la 'dug par gyur/ hrīḥṣtī sa bsangs/ swa bha wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ smon lam gyis nas/ mtshams rnams su zla ba'i gdan/ de rnams kyi steng du lha'i mtshan ma rnams so so'i gnas su yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su ya las thod dbyug yas mtshan pa las/ bcom ldan 'das zhe sdang gshin rje gshed nas/ dmar mos 'khyud pa/ 'dab ma bzhi la shar du kṣe las thod dbyug kṣes mtshan pa las/ gti mug nas/ nag mos 'khyud pa/ lho ru ma las thod dbyug mas mtshan pa las/ ser sna nas/ ser mos 'khyud pa/ nub tu me las thod dbyug mes mtshan pa las/ 'dod chags nas dkar mos 'khyud pa/ byang du da las thod dbyug das mtshan pa las/ phra dog nas ljang mos 'khyud pa/ dpa' bo thams cad nas/ kha brgyan pa'o/ /dbus su gtso bo yab yum dang*/ bdag nyid gnyis su med par gyur/ yum gyi mkha' nas atma ko3haṃ/ snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgras/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bkug /zhal du zhugs/ byang chub kyi sems su zhu bar gyur/ rdo rje'i lam nas byung ba'i byang chub kyi sems kyi 'od zer gyis nam mkha'i khams thams cad yongs su gang bar gyur/ sems can thams cad kyi ma dag pa'i phung po lnga dang*/ nyon mongs pa lnga dang*/ khams lnga dang*/ dbang po drug rnam par shes pa'i tshogs dang bcas pa dang*/ snod kyi 'jig rten mtha' dag yongs su sbyang nas yang dag pa'i ye shes kyi bdag nyid sgrib pa thams cad dang rnam par bral bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed dmar po'i dkyil 'khor gyi tshogs su gyur pa thams cad byang chub kyi sems 'od zer dang bcas pa slar 'dus te gcig tu gyur pa mkha' nang du/ skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed dmar po lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa yongs su rdzogs pa grub par gyur/ oṃ hrīḥṣtī nas swā hā 'i/ mkha' nang gi gtso bo yab yum gsang ba'i lam nas spros/

phyi'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo yab yum la thim oṃ mo hanta kṛta hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ mo ha ra ti hūṃ dzaḥ mkha' nang gi gti mug gshin rje gshed yab yum phyir phyung*/ shar gyi gti mug gshin rje gshed yab yum la thim/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ pi shu na/ pi shu na/ mkha' nang gi ser sna/ lho'i ser sna/ rā ga /rā ga /mkha' nang gi 'dod chags/ nub kyi 'dod chags/ irṣa/ iṣya/ mkha' nang gi phrag dog /byang gi phrag dog /oṃ āḥhūṃ lan bzhi/ mkha' nang gi bum pa bzhi/ mtshams bzhi'i bum pa bzhi/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ mkha' nang gi gzhal yas khang bsrung ba'i 'khor lo dang bcas pa phyir phyung*/ phyi'i gzhal yas khang bsrung ba'i 'khor lo dang bcas pa la thim/ snying gar hūṃ nas brlabs par gyur/ rang gi snying ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ nas/ dza hūṃ baṃ hoḥ 'i bar rnams sgrub thabs bzhin/ yang rang gi snying ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ sta gon gyi ye shes pa rten dang brten par bcas pa thams cad badzra sa mā dzaḥ rol mo dang bcas pa hrīḥṣtī bzla zhing bgegs bskrad/ hrīḥṣtī gcig gis bsrung ba'i sgo phye/ oṃ hrī ha bho mahā kro dhā ā gatstsha ā gatstsha/ asma ta pū dza pra ti gṛ hṇāntu pra sā dha me dhī man ku ru ku ru swāhā/ zhes rdo rje'i gur gyi nang du spyan drangs/ hrīḥṣtīḥ gcig bzlas pas sgo bcings/ yab yum bcu'i sngags re re'i mthar/ arghaṃ pra tītstsha swāhā/ zhes sbyar te mchod yon phul/ puṣpe nas shapta 'i bar gyis mchod/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku/ / sogs kyis bstod/ dkyil 'khor chen po byin gyis brlabs te dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol zhes gsol ba btab/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gtso bo yab yum la lan gsum gsum/ lhag ma lha bzhi/ bum pa bzhi/ rten gyi dkyil 'khor rnams la dmigs nas re re brjod de/ yang dag par bsre bar bya'o/ / de nas mchod pa rnams bsangs sbyangs/

stong pa'i ngang las/ a las byung ba'i nas shapta āḥhūṃ gi bar gyis gong bzhin byin gyis brlabs/ de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ bsdu na sngags tsam gyis kyang chog la/ shin tu rgyas par na sngon gyi mkhas pa rnams kyis mdzad pa'i mchod chog rgyas pa rnams ltar bya/ 'dir 'bring po'i tshul du brjod na/ dag cing dri med yid 'ong ba'i/ /sngags kyi yon chab mchog 'di dag /mchog tu dad pas khyed la 'bul/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/ oṃ hrīḥṣtī haḥ de bzhin du/ sngags kyi zhabs bsil zhes dang*/ oṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ chu dang thang las skyes pa yi/ /me tog dam pa 'di dag ni/ /mchog tu gus pas bdag 'bul na/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/ / gtso 'khor bcu'i snying po'i thar/ oṃ ku ma ra rū pi ṇe dzaḥdzaḥ lhan cig skyes dang sbyar las byung*/ /bdug spos dam pa 'di dag ni/ /mchog tu dad pas 'bul lags na/ /ci bde= oṃ hrī ha he phaṭa/ zhun mar 'bru mar mar me 'di/ /lha rdzas 'bar bas mun pa 'joms/ /mi shes thams cad 'joms pa'i phyir/ /bdag nyid dad pas 'bul bar gyis/ /oṃ dipta nas swāhā/ lhan cig skyes dang sbyar ba yi/ /dri mchog dam pa 'di dag ni/ /mchog tu dad pas bdag 'bul na/ /ci bde bar ni khyod kyis bzhes/ /oṃ bi nas gaḥ kha dog dri dang ro ldan pa'i/ /bza' dang bca' bar yang dag ldan/ /thams cad sbyar ba'i kha zas 'di/ /'bul gyi yang dag bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ badzra ne we tya ā:hūṃ/ sil snyan la sogs rol mo'i tshogs/ /dbyangs kyi nga ro ldan pa 'di/ /mchog tu dad pas bdag 'bul gyis/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ badzra shapta āḥhūṃ/ kha dog bzang zhing dri zhim reg na bde/ /srab 'jam yangs mdzes lha las byung ba yi/ /na bza' mchog 'di rdo rje'i sku la 'bul/ /bgres pa med pa rdo rje'i sku thob shog /oṃ badzra wastast+ra ye āḥhūm̐/ gzung 'dzin nga rgyal bcom pa'i stag lpags dang*/

/nyon mongs sha khrag zad pa'i thod skam dang*/ /bdud rigs gshin rje bsad pa'i mgo bo'i 'phreng*/ /dug lnga 'joms byed bdug pa'i sbrul rgyan 'bul/ /oṃ byā ghra tsarma wa sa ni āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badzra shurka ka pā mu ku ṭa āḥhūṃ/ oṃ rakta muṇḍa mā la a bha ra ṇa āḥhūm̐/ oṃ aṣta nā ga rā dza a laṃ ka ra āḥhūṃ/ gzugs kyi mchod pa khyad par che/ /sgra yi mchod pa yid 'ong ldan/ /dri yi mchod pa tshim pa'i mchog /ro yi mchod pa bla na med/ /reg bya'i mchod pa bde mchog ldan/ / mchod pa rnam pa lnga rnams kyis/ /rab 'byams zhing rnams yongs bkang nas/ / dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la mchod/ /oṃ pañtsa kā ma gu ṇa pū dzi te āḥhūṃ/ 'dzam bu'i gling 'di'am gling gzhan dag /'khor lo rin chen gyis bkang ba/ / stong gsum la sogs de bzhin ste/ /zhum pa med par byas te 'bul/ /oṃ tsakra ratna pū dza/ me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūṃ/ nor bu/ ma ṇi/ btsun mo/ st+ri/ khyim bdag /gṛ ha pa ti/ glang po/ hāsti/ rta mchog a shwa/ blon po/ pu ru ṣa/

zhes sbyar/ de bzhin du/ bkra shis brtags brgyad kyis bkang ba/ / ces dang*/ aṭṭa maṅga la aṃ ka āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang mchod pa'i rnam pa ni/ /rnga yab rdul yab sbrang yab dang*/ khyams dang skyed mos tshal dag dang*/ /gzim mal dang ni gdan khri dang*/ /myur 'gro rta dang glang po dang*/ /yid bzhin nor bu dpag bsam shing*/ / rta babs dang ni bla re sogs/ /bza' btung ro mchog sna tshogs dang*/ /glu gar la sogs mtha' yas mchod/ /bum pa bzang po 'dod 'jo'i ba/ /rin chen lag pa nam mkha'i mdzod/ /blo yis blangs te 'bul bar bgyi/ /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /oṃ sarba bid pū ra pū ra su ra su ra ā warta ya ā warta ya ho/ mchod bum bteg la/ nag po ra ri med pa yi/ /bum pa lto phye bre tshad pa/ /mchu 'phyang mgrin ring gdan dang ldan/ /snying por ldan pa'i sman sogs gzhug / mgrin pa ras bzang dag gis dkris/ /'dab mar ldan pa'i lcugs ma yang*/ / dri dang ldan pa'i kha rgyan can/ /bdud rtsi ldan pa yis kyang mchod/ /gzhan yang mchod pa'i rnams pa ni/ /bla re gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang*/ /ba dan sil snyan rol mo yis/ /gus pas dkyil 'khor pa la mchod/ /bla med mchog gi mchod pa dam pa 'di/ /ye shes lnga yi 'od zer rnam par 'phro/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yis rab tu brgyan/ /dam tshig gsang ba'i mchod par bzhes su gsol/ / zhes brjod de/ phyi mchod rnams so/ /bstod pa ni/ a ye kye kye nas/ yongs la gzigs/ / zhes pa'i rjes su/ ma he dbang phyug chen po lha bdag po/ /gnyug mar gsungs pa'i dngos kyi mnga' bdag po/ /sdig pa 'jigs rung bgegs rnams bcom bdag po/ /gshin rje'i 'khrul 'khor gsang sngags mchog bdag po/ / dbyug pa mkha' dbyug dkar po bsnams pa po/ /mi thod phyag na mi thod 'dzin pa po/ /zung 'jug bde ldan zung 'jug bde ba po/ /gshin rje 'joms mdzad gshin rje gsod pa po/ /mi thod klu yis brgyan byas 'jigs pa po/

/bcos ma'i sku yis sprul zhing mdzad pa po/ / thar bde'i go 'phang gnas su 'god pa po/ /brtan gter blo gter tshe ring gter ba po/ /de bzhin yid mdzad pha rol phyin pa po/ /lhan skyes bde chen gcig thugs dgyes pa po/ /thugs rje ro gcig bsod nams byed pa po/ /thugs gsung las kyi lam ston dge ba po/ /zhabs la lha dbang cod pan btud pa po/ /bgegs tshogs mtha' dag go 'phang bcom pa po/ /nor ster sku mdog nyi ltar dmar ba po/ /bde chen gshin rje gshed la bdag phyag 'tshal/ / zhes gtso bo la bstod/ gti mug rdo rje nas dbang phyug khyod phyag 'tshal bar dang*/ rtse dang shes rab pha rol phyin/ /nam mkha'i khams ni rnam par sbyong*/ /nyon mongs kun dag ye shes dngos/ /rdo rje ro langs mar phyag 'tshal/ / rdo rje zhi ba byang chub sems/ /gti mug rdo rje nyid dbyer med/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi bdag mo che/ /rdo rje tsartsi kār phyag 'tshal/ /mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes ni/ /zhe sdang bdag po thugs dbyer med/ /mi phyed rnam rtog rab gcod ma/ /rdo rje phag mo khyod phyag 'tshal/ /rdo rje gsung ni ye shes che/ /padma shes rab pha rol phyin/ / 'dod chags chen po nyid sbyor ba/ /rdo rje mthar mdzad khyod la bstod/ /rdo rje las ni kun grol ba/ /phrag dog rdo rje dbyer med sku/ /thams cad rdo rje btang snyoms ni/ /rdo rje las la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sgeg sogs rdo rje lha mo brgyad/ / snod dang gang ba'i bum par sprul/ /sna tshogs 'dod yon bdud rtsi'i gzugs/ / mchod ldan de dag rnams la bstod/ /byang chub phyogs chos sum cu bdun/ /ye shes gzhal yas khang par sprul/ /'jig tshogs lta kun 'joms byed pa'i/ /rdo rje'i gzhi dang bcas la 'dud/ /ye shes nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ /nyes spangs padma'i 'khor yug ste/ /bdud 'joms bsrung ba'i 'khor lo ni/ /ye shes me dpung 'bar la bstod/

/de ltar dkyil 'khor 'khor lo bcas bstod pas/ /bdud bzhi 'joms zhing las kun 'grub pa dang*/ /lha mo'i 'khor gyis bskor ba'i dpa' bo ni/ /bde chen gshin rje gshed dpal thob par shog / ces bstod/ chang la bdud rtsi ril bu sbyar ba slar yang byin gyis brlabs te 'grub na lag mchod bya zhing*/ ma 'grub na lha so so'i snying po'i mthar/ 'bru gsum sbyar bas g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis bdud rtsi 'bul/ phyis kyi lag len ltar spros pa la dga' na/ dang por bla ma rnams kyis mtshan nas smos shing 'bru gsum gyis 'bul ba dang*/ mtha' mar dgos kyi chos skyong dang*/ chos skyong spyi dang phyogs skyong 'khor bcas dang rigs drug la sbyin pa sogs kyang bya ste/ de yang*/ 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed dang bi rū pa/ /ḍombhi he ru ka dang dpal 'dzin zhabs/ /blo gros bzang po darban ā tsārya/ /glo bo lo tsā shes rab rin chen dang*/ /thugs sras sa pa lo tsā mchog ldan dang*/ /sangs rgyas sras dang gzhon nu tshul khrims zhabs/ / tshul khrims rgyal mtshan mkhan chen grub she dang*/ /shes rab rgya mtsho rwa ston yon tan dpal/ /byang sems mchog grub rje btsun grol mchog zhabs/ /mkhas btsun bzang po'i mthar thug kun dga'i mtshan/ /ye shes bdud rtsi rgya mtsho'i mchod pa 'bul/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang dbang bskur rgyud bshad sogs dang*/ mtshan sngags sam snying po rnams kyi dkyil 'khor la 'bul/ gzhan yang rgyud sde bzhi dang sogs dang*/ dgos kyi chos skyong la snying pos phul/ gzhan yang bstan pa bsrung bar sogs dang*/ gzhan yang phyogs skyong ba bco lnga lha chen po brgyad sogs kyis phul/ gzhan yang bod khams skyong ba sogs kyis phul/ gzhan yang 'gro ba rigs drug sogs kyi mthar/ oṃ a mṛ ta swa da na badzra swa bha wātma ko3haṃ/ zhes bdud rtsi myang ba rnams so/ /nang mchod do/ /dngos sam yid kyi sgron ma lnga dang*/

bdud rtsi lnga phul te/ dri chen rdo rje'i chur ldan byang sems dkar dmar dang*/ /mi sha rta dang ba glang glang chen khyi sha ste/ /sgron ma che dang ldan pas dur khrod mdzes byas pas/ /rnam par rtog bral bde gshegs 'khor lo dam pa mchod/ / ces brjod de gsang mchod do/ / mngon rtogs ltar mkha' gsang byin gyis brlabs te bde ba sgom pa ni/ de kho na nyid kyis mchod pa'o/ /de nas sgrub thabs kyi gtor chog nas 'byung ba ltar nang gtor rnams a mṛ ta sa bsangs pa nas/ chen por gyur zhes pa'i bar gyi byin gyis brlabs/ ljags rdo rje'i sbu gu'i nang nas/ naṃ dza/ zhes pa'i bar gyis phul/ chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod dang*/ nang mchod dang*/ gti mug rdo rje sogs kyis bstod/ mchod sbyin sogs 'dod don gsol ba btab/ bar 'dir mgon po lcam dral sogs chos skyong rnams dang*/ gzhi bdag gtor ma sogs kyang btang*/ phyogs skyong la yang nang gtor 'bul bar 'dod na/ 'jig rten 'das pa'i lha spyan 'dren gyi tshig bor nas/ lhag ma gtor chog sgrub thabs su bshad pa ji lta ba bzhin no/ /de nas phyi rol gtor ma ni/ gtor ma che ba sha chang ba dan sogs kyis brgyan pa mchod pa dang bcas pa phyi rol tu bshams/ mchod pa byin brlabs dang*/ gtor ma byin brlabs sngar bzhin byas nas/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs skyong ba 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad spyan drangs/ hrīḥṣtīḥ 'i mthar/ oṃ dā sha dika lo ka pā la sa pa ri wa ra ā karṣa ya dzaḥ gtor snod kyi phyogs bcur 'khod pa ni nas/ thams cad kyis bskor bar gyur/ de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ nas/ gsol bar gyur/ oṃ ant+ra ya nas/ pheṃ swāhā/ oṃ da sha dika lo ka pā la sa pa ri wa ra bhyaḥ zhes mgor bor sbyar la arghaṃ nas shapta 'i bar gyis mchod pa'i tshe/ mchod pa rnams gtor snod du blugs/ 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod phul/ bdud bzhi po ni

nas/ 'dud kyi bar gyis bstod/ gang du bcom ldan 'das lhan cig / 'ongs pa'i phyogs kyi bdag po rnams/ /gang yang rjes su 'brang bcas 'dir/ / 'khor ba de dag thams cad rnams/ /bdag ni rjes su bzung ba'i phyir/ /ji ltar rigs par gyur pa yi/ /dri dang me tog sogs gtor ma/ /so sor bzhes te sems can la/ /byams pa'i sems dang slob ma la/ /gegs med par ni mdzad du gsol/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ / sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ rdo rje slob dpon bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don gyi phyir/ zhes pa nas/ song zhig ces pa'i bar gong ltar brjod/ slob mas mchod yon gyi lhag ma 'gro phyogs su sbreng te/ oṃ hrīḥbi shuddha 'i sngags brjod cing*/ gtor ma gtsang sar dor/ slob dpon gyi tsham rngam byed cing*/ gzhan rnams kyis rol mo'i sgra bsgrags/ mthar slob dpon gyis rting mnan nas nang du 'ongs/ khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi nga rgyal dang bcas me tog blangs la/ hūṃ bzhi pa'i sngags 'don zhing dkyil 'khor gyi mthar 'ongs nas/ oṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ hūṃ a phaṭa/ oṃ āḥ.aḥ.aḥphaṭa/ oṃ hūṃ/ ha na mā ra ya duṣtaṃ/ ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/ āḥ.aḥhūṃ hri phaṭa/ ces bzlas shing*/ rdo rje dril stabs dang*/ rkang stabs gang yang rung bas dkyil 'khor la bskor ba lan gsum byas nas/ gzhi rtsa drag po dang*/ g.yon brkyang las/ lag pa hūṃ mdzad kyi phyag rgya/ las mdzub mo lto sprad de dral ba sgo dbye ba'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ badzra urgha ṭa ya sa ma ya pra be sha ya hūṃ/ zhes pa'i sngags kyis nub nas shar sgo dbye/ de bzhin du byang nas lho sgo dang*/ shar nas nub sgo dang*/ lho nas byang sgo dbye bar mos/ me tog dor/ oṃ sa ma ya pra be sha ya mi/ zhes pas me tog blangs nas/ spyi bor bcings pa'i gar stabs bya/ /sems can kun la dngos grub ni/ /ma lus dang bas bstsal du gsol/ / zhes gsol ba 'debs shing*/

phyag bya/ phyogs mtshams brgyad du ba dan brgyad 'bul/ spro na skabs 'dir yan lag bdun pa dang*/ bzlas pa yang ci 'grub bya'o/ /de nas zhi ba'am/ rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg gis kyang lha mnyes par bya ste/ deng sang lag len byed pa nyung yang 'grub na nges par dgos pa yin no/ / gsum pa ni/ phyis kyi lag len rnams ltar na/ 'og nas 'byung ba ltar dkyil 'khor gyi 'jug pa nas brtsams te/ dbang gi bya ba mtha' dag bdag 'jug tu len pa ltar byas kyang rung la/ yang lugs 'di 'dzin pa snga ma rnams kyi bzhed pa ltar na/ 'phreng ba nas bshad pa'i bdag 'jug 'bring po dang mthun par mdzad pas/ yol ba'i nang du 'jug pa yan chad 'og nas 'byung ba ltar byas la/ oṃ badzra urgha ṭa ya sa ma ya pra be sha ya hūṃ/ zhes pas shar sgo phye nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi nang du/ oṃ mchog tu bde ba'i sems ni rol par ldan/ /sgeg pa'i phyag gis bcom ldan 'das la 'dud/ /dza hūṃ baṃ ho hi ho hi hi hīḥ mgon po snyim pa'i me tog so sor bzhes/ ho zhes me tog dor la/ slar yang spyi bor bcings ste me tog 'phreng ba'i dbang ngo*/ /'jug pa'i cho ga de tsam gyis chog la/ de nas maṇḍal phul te chu dbang man chad rdzogs par blang ngo*/ /mthar dam tshig gsum gyi glu blangs kyang rung ma blang kyang rung*/ sems can kun gyi yid khyab pa/ /sems can kun gyi yid la gnas/ /sems can kun gyi yab kyang yin/ /dam tshig mchog gi 'dod pa mchog /bden pa gang gis ye shes mchog /shes rab thabs bdag dkyil 'khor gyi/ /bden pa'i byin rlabs gang yin pa/ /bden pa de yis mgon khyod kyis/ khyod kyi 'dod pa rab rdzogs mdzod/ /chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med/ /bzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las la yang dag 'byung*/ /de bzhin de nyid nges par 'byung*/ /bden pa de yi dkyil 'khor ni/ /gzugs brnyan gsal bar slob ma rnams/

/kun gyis sgrib med mthong bar shog / ces bden stobs brjod pa lan gsum bya/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i bya ba yod na'ang skabs 'dir bya zhing*/ srung ma'i gtor ma rnam snang ma btags na lhag gtor dang dus gcig tu gtong*/ bzhi pa la dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa dang*/ dbang bskur ba gnyis las dang po ni slob ma rnams khrus byas yol ba'i phyi rol du 'khod pa la sngon 'gro'i chos bshad/ slob mas maṇḍal phul/ mā ma ki dang lhan cig sbyor/ / sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ khyad par gzhan bdag 'jug la ni rgyun gshags 'di bya ste/ lus dang ngag dang yid kyis sdig /bgyis dang de bzhin bgyid bstsal dang*/ /gang yang rjes su yi rang ba/ /de kun dus gsum mgon la bshags/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas dang de yi sras/ /'phags rnams dge tshogs rjes yi rang*/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas dang dam pa'i chos/ /tshogs mchog bcas la skyabs su 'chi/ /yon tan rgya mtsho khyed rnams la/ /bdag gi lus 'di dbul bar bgyi/ /dam pa'i chos kun ston pa yis/ /sgra dbyangs mdzes pas bzhugs su gsol/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang*/ /de sras lam gyur sbyin sogs tshul/ /sku gsung ye shes thob bya'i phyir/ /rab tu dang bas brten par bgyi/ /sems can kun gyi don sgrub phyir/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed bgyid/ /bsod nams kun nas gang bsags pa/ /bla med byang chub thob phyir bsngo/ /dpal ldan gshin rje mthar byed du/ /gyur nas bdag gis 'gro phan bgyid/ / ces so/ / slob ma dbang bskur la ni rgyun bshags dang sdom bzung sta gon skabs song bas/ dngos gzhi'i nyin mi dgos la/ ci ste byed na dris lan gyi 'gor byed pa mi legs te/ bdag 'jug bzhin 'dir bya'o/ /de'i rjes su snga ma rnams kyi bzhed pa ltar na chas 'jug gsum yang mdzad/ oṃ tsakṣu bandha wā ra ma na ya hūṃ gis mig dar bcings/ a khaṃ wāṃ ra hūṃ gis me tog gtad/

hrīḥṣtā ི'i sngags kyis bsangs/ slob ma rnams gti mug gshin rje gshed du skad cig gis bskyed/ snying gar rdo rje'i lte bar nyi ma la hūṃ nag po dang*/ mgrin par padma'i lte bar nyi ma la āḥdamar po dang*/ spyi bor 'khor lo'i lte bar zla ba la oṃ dkar po/ de rnams kyi 'od kyis lus gang bas sgo gsum gyi dri ma sbyangs par mos la/ gnas gsum du dri'i thig le bya/ slar yang hrīḥṣtī bzlas pa'i yungs kar gyis gtor/ gu gul gyi bdug cing*/ las bum gyi chus bsang ngo*/ /de nas/ kyai dga' ba la dga' khyod su yin zhes dri zhing*/ bde chen bdag ni skal bzang lags zhes lan btab/ slob ma'i snying khar zla ba la rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūṃ gis mtshan pa bskyed la/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsitta uta pa ta ya mi/ zhes rjes zlos bya/ me tog dang bcas pa'i rdo rje snying gar gtugs la/ su ra te sa ma ya st+waṃ siddhi badzra ya tha su khaṃ zhes brtan par byas/ lugs rnying pa rnams ltar na/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs kyi/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di/ dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa la smra bar mi bya ste/ ma dad par yang mi bya'o/ /

zhes skabs 'dir gsang gdams mdzad pa nyid legs so/ /de nas oṃ ya mantā kṛta hūṃ zhes pas khrod nas/ aḥ khaṃ bi ra hūṃ/ yol ba'i nang du bcug /spro na lugs rnying pa thams cad nas bskor ba dang phyag bdun byed par bshad pa ltar byas na legs shing*/ mdor bsdus pa'i tshe phyis kyi lag len ltar ma byas kyang rung ngo*/ /de nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyi/ de bas na ngas khyod la rdo rje ye shes bskyed par bya ste/ ye shes gang gis khyod kyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub kyang thob par 'gyur na/ dngos grub gzhan rnams lta smos kyang ci dgos/ khyod kyis 'dir dkyil 'khor chen po ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ dam tshig nyams par gyur ta re/ zhes dang*/ rdo rje snying gar bzhag la/ de ring rdo rje sems dpa' rang*/ khyod kyi snying la yang dag zhugs/ / gal te tshul 'di smras na ni/ /de ma thag tu bral te gshegs/ / zhes dang*/ yang spyi bor bzhag la/ 'di ni rdo rje dam tshig ste/ khyod kyi dam tshig rdo rje 'di'o/ /gal te khyod kyis 'ga' zhig la/ /'di smras na ni mgo bo 'gems/ / tho yig rnying pa 'ga' las lha lnga la 'di mi byed par yang bshad cing*/ phyis kyi dkyil chog phal la/ 'di'i tshig rkang gnyis pa med pa ni/ gshed dmar dkyil chog la/ chag lo'i rgya dpe'am chag 'gyur gyi bod dpe thog ma yi ge nor ba'i ma dpe'i skyon du snang bas gzhan nas 'byung ba bzhin bya'o/ /dung chos kyi chu blud cing*/ oṃ badzra u da ka tha lan bdun bzlas/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ / dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed/ /dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub ste/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'thung shig / ces dang*/ yang spyi bor rdo rje bzhag la/ deng nas brtsams te khyod kyi phyag na rdo rje nga yin gyis/ ngas 'di gyis shig ces bsgo ba de khyod kyis bya dgos so/

khyod kyis nga la brnyas par yang mi bya ste/ khyod ya nga ba ma spang par 'chi ba'i dus byas nas/ dmyal bar gyur ta re/ zhes brjod do/ / de nas ye shes dbab pa'i don du gsol ba gdab pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs te/ rdo rje sems dpa' bdag la dbab du gsol/ lan gsum/ slob ma'i spyi bor baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po bum pas mtshan pa la/ haḥdakar po sku rdo rje'i ngo bo/ snying gar laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ser po rdo rje rtse gsum pas mtshan pa la hūṃ nag po thugs rdo rje'i ngo bo/ lte bar raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum 'bar bas mtshan pa la āḥdamar po gsung rdo rje'i ngo bo/ rkang 'og tu yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can g.yo ba'i ba dan gyis mtshan pa la dzhaiḥdamar po drag cing bzod par dka' ba/ rlung dang dzhaiḥ'i 'od zer gyis lte ba'i me drag tu sbar/ snying ga'i sa bsregs te rab tu 'bar ba'i ngo bor gyur pa la/ spyi bo'i chu'i dkyil 'khor las bdud rtsi'i tshogs babs pas tshim zhing bde bas khyab/ sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i yi ge gsum gyi 'od zer gyis lus kyi nang gang zhing*/ dzhaiḥyi 'od zer/ rlung dang bcas pas lus nam mkhar 'degs bzhin par gyur/ sangs rgyas thams cad gshin rje gshed dmar po'i rnam pas ba spu'i bu ga nas zhugs par bsam la/ bdag nyid gshin rje gshed kyi sku mi bzad par gsal bas bsnyems pa dang bcas pas rdo rje bsor la dril bu dkrol/ oṃ hrīḥṣtī bi kri tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa ā be sha ya staṃ bha ya/ ra ra ra ra tsā la ya/ tsā la ya/ hūṃ haḥ.āḥdzhai hūṃ phaṭa/ ces drag tu brjod cing bdug pa dang*/ rol mo'i sgra bya'o/ /mthar tiṣṭha badzra/ zhes spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag pas brtan par bya'o/ /de nas bden pa'i stobs brjod pa ni/

yang dag pa yi dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /bdag gi slob ma gzhug par bgyi/ /lha rnams rigs kyis rim pa dang*/ /bsod nams ci 'dra de 'drar shog /de'i dngos grub ci 'drar 'gyur/ /rigs ni gang gi snod du 'gyur/ /bsod nams mthu yang ci 'dra ba/ /de 'dra dkyil 'khor du gyur cig /de nas nam mkha'i kha dog dris shing lung bstan/ sngar gyi me tog gi phon po las yangs shing ma rnying pa'i me tog gcig traṃ las rin po che'i rang bzhin gyi me tog tu byin gyis brlabs nas phul bar mos la/ oṃ pra tītstsha badzra hoḥ zhes dor/ slar yang slob dpon gyis blang ste/ u dum wa ra mandha ra/ /yongs 'du'i shing dang ma li ka /karṇi ka yi 'phreng ba 'di/ /legs par mnos la bus zungs shig /oṃ pra ti gṛhṇa st+waṃ i maṃ satwa mahā ba la/ zhes slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag ste me tog 'phreng ba'i dbang ngo*/ / snying gar zla ba la hūṃ/ mig gnyis su 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i oṃ/ oṃ de ring rdo rje sems dpa' rang*/ khyod kyi mig ni 'byed par brtson/ /rdo rje'i mig ni bla med pa/ /thams cad mig ni 'byed par mdzad/ / ces gdong g.yogs phye/ de nas blta bar bskul zhing ched du brjod pa 'di'i lugs rnying rnams 'phreng ba ltar mdzad pas/ da ni dad pa'i shugs kyis su/ /dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos/ khyod ni sangs rgyas rigs su skyes/ /phyag rgya sngags kyis byin gyis brlabs/ /dngos grub kun gyis phun sum tshogs/ /dam tshig mchog tu khyod 'gyur gyis/ /rdo rje padma rtse rol bas/ /gsang sngags rnams la sgrub par gyis/ / zhes lta bar bskul/ slob mas thal mo sbyar la/ oṃ rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor dkyil 'khor chen por bdag zhugs so/ /oṃ rnal 'byor dkyil 'khor dkyil 'khor chen po bdag gis mthong*/ /oṃ gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor dkyil 'khor chen por bdag dbang bskur/ /hoḥhoḥhoḥ zhes ched du brjod pa'i rjes zlos bya'o/

/ gtso bo nas/ bsrung ba'i 'khor la ོ'i bar rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad rdzogs par bstan/ yang na gdong g.yogs phye ma thag bstan kyang rung ngo*/ / gnyis pa la/ dbang bzhi bskur ba dang*/ rjes su bya ba'i rim pa gnyis so/ /dang po la bzhi las/ bum pa'i dbang la yang thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa gnyis las/ thun mong ba ni rigs lnga'i dbang ste/ maṇḍal phul nas/ sangs rgyas shes rab chen po yis/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dbang bskur ltar/ /de bzhin bdag la dbang bskur zhing*/ /mchog kyang bdag la bstsal du gsol/ / zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab/ bum chu rnams rnam rgyal bum par bsdus la/ slob ma dang*/ dbang rdzas rnams la las bum chu dang*/ hrīḥṣtī sa bsangs/ oṃ swa bha wa sogs/ bdag dang*/ dbang rdzas dang*/ slob ma rnams mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las/ paṃ las padma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i gdan la ya las dbyug pa yas mtshan pa las/ gsum ga'ang zhe sdang gshin rje gshed sku mdog dmar po la/ yum rdo rje ro langs mas 'khyud pa/ dbyug pa dang*/ thod khrag 'dzin pa/ stag lpags dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ /dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis sangs rgyas thams cad zhe sdang gshin rje gshed kyi rnam par badzra sa mā dzaḥ dam tshig pa rnams dang ro gcig tu gyur/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ dkyil chog gsar pa rnams na dbang rdzas la dbang bskur bar 'dod kyang*/ rnying pa rnams na de med pa ltar 'dir yang 'dod do/ / dbang rdzas kyi zhe sdang gshin rje gshed zhu ba las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i chur gyur/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa 'khor dang btsun mor bcas pa'i lha tshogs thams cad spyan drangs/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs/ arghaṃ nas shapta 'i bar gyis mchod/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/

/mchod chen ji ltar bstsal ba ltar/ /bdag kyang bskyab pa'i don gyi phyir/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol/ / zhes gsol ba btab/ so so'i rig ma dang snyoms par zhugs pas byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zhu bdag gi tshangs bug nas zhugs/ rdo rje'i lam nas lha mo'i padmar lhung ba/ rgyal ba rigs lnga yum bzhi/ byang chub sems dpa' brgyad rdo rje ma drug /khro bo'i dbang po/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa dbang gi lha'i dkyil 'khor du gyur pa mkha' nang nas phyir spros te/ slob ma'i steng gi nam mkha' la bzhugs/ de bzhin gshegs pa sras dang bcas pas dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ khro bo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ rig pa'i lha mo rnams kyis glu dang gar dang*/ me tog gi tshogs la sogs pas mchod/ rdo rje tsartsi kā la sogs pa yum bzhi po rnams kyis rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis gang ba thogs te/ bkra shis kyi glu dbyangs dang bcas pas dbang bskur bar mos shig /bkra shis gang zhig sems can kun gyi snying la gnas/ /kun gyi bdag nyid rigs kun gyi ni bdag po mchog /sems can ma lus skyed byed bde ba chen po ste/ /de ni deng khyod dbang bskur mchog la bkra shis shog / ces me tog dor/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni/ khams gsum kun gyi phyag byas pa/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /gsang gsum gnas byung sbyin par bya/ /oṃ badzra a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ zhes rdo rje dang bcas pa'i khu tshur gyis bzung ba'i yal 'dab kyis bum chu spyi bor gtor zhing 'thung du bcug / de ltar bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dgachu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ de nyid la mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūṃ nas/ nai wi te āḥhūṃ/ dngos su mchod pa lngas mchod par yang bya'o/ /de ltar na/ mi bskyod pa chu'i dbang thob/

zhe sdang dag /rnam shes gnas gyur/ me long lta bu'i ye shes mngon du byas/ mi bskyod pa'i go 'phang thob 'gyur gyi nus pa sos btab/ zhe sdang gshin rje gshed kyi sgo nas las dang dngos grub thams cad sgrub pa la dbang ngo*/ / zhes brjod/ 'di man chad la/ dbang lha spyan 'dren pa nas shis brjod kyi bar mi dgos/ gzhan stong par sbyang ba nas rtog pa bskyed pa'i bar rigs 'gre bar byas te/ 'don pa spo ba'i tshul brjod na/ bdag dang dbang rdzas dbu rgyan dang*/ ma las dbyug pa mas mtshan pa las/ ser sna gshin rje gshed ser po la/ yum phag mo ser mos 'khyud pa/ ser sna gshin rje gshed kyi rnam par/ ser sna gshin rje gshed zhu ba las byung ba'i rin po che'i dbu rgyan du gyur/ dbu rgyan bcings/ dar dpyangs dkon la/ dbang bskur rdo rje nas a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ dbang gi lha las de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga'i tshogs rnams byung*/ dbu rgyan gyi nang du zhugs par gyur/ bum pa'i chus kyang gtor te/ oṃ badzra a bhi ṣiñtsa mi chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyi dbu rgyan/ rin chen 'byung ldan dbu rgyan gyi/ nga rgyal dang ser sna/ tshor ba/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyi go 'phang*/ ser sna dang gshin rje gshed kyi sgo nas/ yig rnying 'ga' na skabs 'dir rdo rje ma/ sngags rgyas dbang bskur ba dang*/ dar dpyangs sbyin pa sogs 'phreng ba bzhin mdzad pa ni/ bcu gsum ma'i dkyil chog gi dgongs par yang mngon mod/ snga phyi phal cher mi byed par mang bas 'dir yang spyi dang mthun par byas so/ /de nas rdo rje'i dbang ni/ dbang rdzas rnams rdo rje me las dbyug pa mes mtshan pa las/ 'dod chags gshin rje gshed dmar po la yum dbyangs can ma dkar mos 'khyud pa/ dbang rdzas kyi 'dod chags gshin rje gshed/ rdo rjer sangs rgyas kun gyi dbang gi de ring khyod dbang bskur/

'di de sangs rgyas thams cad nyid/ /rab tu sgrub phyir rdo rje bzung*/ / rdo rje snying ga la sogs pa'i gnas gsum du gtugs la/ lag pa g.yas su sbyin/ oṃ badzra sogs gong bzhin chus kyang dbang bskur te/ 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan/ 'od dpag med rdo rje'i 'dod chags/ 'du shes/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ 'od dpag med kyi 'dod chags gshin rje gshed kyi dril bu'i dbang la/ dbang rdzas dril bu/ da las dbyug pa das mtshan pa las/ phra dog gshin rje gshed ljang khu la yum gau ri ljang mos 'khyud pa/ dbang rdzas kyi phra dog gshin rje gshed / dril bur/ oṃ badzra a dhi pa ti st+waṃ/ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ tiṣṭha badzra sa ma ya st+waṃ/ dril bu lag pa g.yon par gtad/ chus kyang dbang bskur/ don yod grub pas dbu brgyan/ don yod grub pa dril bu'i/ phrag dog /'du byed/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ don grub kyi phrag dog gshin rje gshed kyi/ ming dbang ni/ dbang rdzas med pa'i phyir dbang rdzas dang 'brel ba'i tshig gang yang brjod mi dgos/ bdag dang slob ma/ kṣe las dbyug pa kṣes mtshan pa las/ gnyis ka'ang*/ gti mug gshin rje gshed dkar po la/ yum tsartsi ka nag mos 'khyud pa/ slob dpon gyis rdo dril bsnol ba lag pa g.yas pas bzung ste/ slob ma'i mgo steng du 'khrol bzhin pas/ oṃ badzra satwa st+waṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi badzra na maḥ.a bhi ṣe ka ta kyai dpal che ge mo rdo rje zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ / zhes rigs dang mthun pa'i ming btags/ chus kyang dbang bskur rnam snang gi dbu brgyan/ rnam par snang mdzad ming gi /gti mug /gzugs phung*/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi/ gti mug gshin rje gshed kyi/ mthar 'di skad du/ dbang bskur ba 'di dag gis bya ba dang spyod pa'i rgyud bshad pa dang*/ sngags sgrub pa la dbang bar 'gyur ro/ /dbang lnga po 'di nyid cod pan gyis dbang ste/ thams cad du tsartsi ka la sogs pa rnams cod pan la sogs pa dbang gi tshul du bya ba'i phyir ro/

/ zhes brjod/ 'dir gshin rje gshed rigs lnga bskyed pa mi rung bar 'dod pa'ang mi 'thad la/ lugs rnying pa 'gar rgyal ba rigs lnga nyid bskyed pa yang shin tu legs te/ 'og tu slob dpon gyi dbang la zhe sdang gshin rje gshed dang*/ rdo rje 'chang sgom pa yang ngo*/ / gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang ni/ maṇḍal phul la/ gang gis bdag gis khyod drin las/ /rang dang gzhan don nus gyur pa/ /rdo rje slob dpon gyis ni dbang*/ /snying rje'i gter gyis bdag la stsol/ / zhes gsol ba btab la/ bdag 'jug gi skabs yin na/ rigs lnga'i sdom bzung yang bya/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su padma 'dab brgyad shig stan dang bcas pa'i steng du slob ma bzhag pa'am/ bzhag par mos la/ dbang stegs rin po che'i khri'i gdan gyi steng du slob ma dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo rdo rje sems dpa'i bdag nyid zhe sdang gshin rje gshed sku mdog dmar po yum rdo rje ro langs ma dmar mos 'khyud pa sogs gong bzhin/ hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje bdud thams cad 'joms par byed pa'i ral grir byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ral gri che/ khams gsum pa yis phyag byas pa/ /las kyi ral gri mchog lta bu/ /bdud las rgyal bar bya phyir bzung*/ /
