zhes gtad la/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje snyems tshul bdag po'i bdag /bcom ldan 'das dpal mchog dang po'i skyes bu'o/ / zhes rdo rje'am de kho na nyid brjod cing don bshad/ a las byung ba'i dril bu thabs dang shes rab kyi bdag nyid du gyur/ shes rab thabs kyi rang bzhin nyid/ /rdo rje dril bu rab sgrub phyir/ /bu yis yang dag gus pas bzung*/ khyod kyis slob ma bsdu bar gyis/ / zhes gtad nas/ srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i srid pa mchog /srid pa dam pa byed par 'gyur/ / zhes dril bu'i de nyid brjod cing don bshad/ slob ma bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed rang snang*/ ye shes kyi phyag rgya rdo rje ro langs ma lo bcu drug lon pa lta bu la yang dag par 'khyud pa'i bde ba dam pa thob pa na/ lha sku dang*/ bde ba dang*/ stong pa zung du 'jug pa'i ye shes 'di ni bum pa'i dbang gi gtso bo'o/ / 'khyud rgya byed du bcug la/ yid kyi lus brtan de nyid ni/ /phyag rgya'i dam tshig rab tu brjod/ /gang gi lus ni thams cad brtan/ /des na phyag rgyar rab tu bsgrags/ / zhes brjod la don bshad/ de nas dbang bskur sogs sngon bzhin chu dbang bskur ba las/ khyad par ni rnam rgyal chen po dung chos kyi dbang bskur ba dang*/ sngags kyang oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi bhe ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūṃ swāhā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra ā tsarya a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūṃ/ zhes dang*/ rdo rje 'chang chen pos dbu brgyan/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dbang gi lha thams cad kyang slob ma la gnyis su med par thim/ dza hūṃ baṃ hoḥ oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swāhā/ zhes me tog gtor/ rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pa'i bkra shis brjod/ de la 'di dag tu/ dbang bskur ba'i las byed pa po ni/

dbang lnga po la/ yum bzhi yin la/ slob dpon gyi dbang la ni gtso bo nyid rig mar bcas pa'o/ /dbang re re'i mthar/ dbang lha slob ma la bstim pa'i tshe/ chu dbang du bshad pa ltar/ dbang lha spyan 'dren yang re re bzhin dgos la/ gang dag slob ma dang dbang rdzas la dbang bskur ba'i rjes su ye shes pa 'jug pa dang*/ dbang 'di rnams thams cad la dbang gi lha spyan 'dren med pa de dag ni cho ga cung zad 'khrul ba yin zhing*/ dbang bskur gyi rjes su ye shes pa 'jug pa pha rgyud kyis khyad chos nges pa can yin no snyam pa las byung ba te 'khrul ba'i rgyun gyi 'khrul ba'o/ /slob ma la shis brjod mi byed pa ni/ dpal 'dzin gyi rjes su 'brang bzhin du de'i gzhung dang yang 'gal ba'o/ / de nas de kho na nyid brjod par bya ste/ 'di la dkyil 'khor dang lha'i de kho na nyid brjod nas/ slob dpon gyi de kho na nyid mi brjod pa ni/ brjed ngas kyi dbang du gyur pa'i ngang tshul can te/ des na de kho na nyid brjod phyin gsum gar brjod dgos so/ /dkyil 'khor dang lha'i de nyid mngon rtogs kyi dag pa bzhin brjod na/ lha'i de nyid sngon la 'byung ba'i phyir/ go rim cung zad 'khrugs par 'gyur na'ang*/ de nyid kyang*/ rgyud kyi tshig yin pas shin tu legs par ni 'gyur la/ 'on kyang mdor bsdu na/ rgyud las 'byung ba 'di tsam gyis kyang chog ste/ dkyil 'khor gru bzhi bden pa bzhi/ /zur bzhi tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi ste/ /sgo bzhi bdud bzhi skrag par mdzad/ /rta babs bzhi ni bsdu ba bzhi/ / zhes dkyil 'khor gyi de nyid dang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyi rtse bar mdzad/ /zhe sdang gshin rje gshed gzugs su/ /zhe sdang gis mnan 'gro gzigs nas/ /zhe sdang thams cad zad par mdzad/ /bcom ldan = /gti mug gshin rje = /gti mug ni/ gti mug thams cad = /bcom ldan phra ma gshin rje/ phra ma yi mnan 'gro = /phra ma thams cad/

bcom ldan/ 'dod chags gshin rje/ 'dod chags kyi/ 'dod chags thams cad/ /bcom ldan phra dog /gshin rje/ /phrag dog /phrag dog thams cad zad par mdzad/ / byams pa tsartsi kar gsungs te/ /phag mo de bzhin snying rje'o/ /dbyangs can dga' bar shes bya ste/ /btang snyoms gau rī'i gzugs su'o/ /chags sogs gzhan gyur sku mdog dmar/ /dus gsum mkhyen pas spyan gsum ste/ /mtha' gnyis rtog spangs phyag gnyis te/ /thabs dang shes rab yang dag sbyor/ / zhes brjod/ slob dpon gyi de kho na nyid brjod pa ni/ slob dpon gyis las bsrung ba'i dam tshig dang*/ gtor ma'i cho ga dang*/ bsrung ba dang*/ phyir bzlog dang*/ dkyil 'khor sgrub pa dang*/ slob ma 'jug pa la sogs pa slob dpon gyi las rnams sgrubs shig / ces brjod/ de la spyir de kho na nyid gsum po 'di dag slob dpon gyi dbang bskur ba thob pa la spyi tsam nas bshad dgos pa yin gyi/ dbang gi cho ga'i yan lag tu mtha' gcig tu dgos pa ni ma yin no/ /de'i phyir dkyil 'khor cho ga tshad ldan mang po zhig las ni mi 'byung la/ 'byung ba rnams la'ang tshig gi brjod tshul sna tshogs yod cing dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa'i dmar nag gi dkyil chog na/ rgyas par bzhugs pa yang mar me mdzad bzang po'i bzhi brgya lnga bcu par gsungs pa'i 'grel pa lta bur sbyar ba yin gyi/ rgyud kyi tshig ma yin no/ / de rjes su mtha' rten rnams sbyin par bya ste/ de la rjes gnang dang*/ brtul zhugs dang*/ lung bstan dang*/ gsang ba bsgrags pa dang*/ dbugs dbyung ba'o/ /dang po ni / slob ma skad cig gis gshin rje gshed dpal zhe sdang rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i rnam pa can du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las/ bhruṃ hūṃ oṃ dzriṃ khaṃ rnams las byung ba'i 'khor lo rnam par snang mdzad kyi rang bzhin/ rdo rje mi bskyod pa'i rang bzhin/ nor bu rin chen 'byung ldan gyi rang bzhin/

padma 'od dpag med kyis rang bzhin/ ral gri don yod grub pa'i rang bzhin rnams su gyur/ rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan rim pas lag tu gtod/ sems can kun la phan don phyir/ /'jig rten kun tu thams cad nas/ /ji ltar sna tshogs 'dul 'gyur ba'i/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ / de bzhin du rdo rje/ rin chen/ padma/ sna tshogs 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ zhes brjod do/ / gnyis pa ni/ rdo rje stong pa'i ngang las/ hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas rang snang gi shes rab ma la 'khyud pa/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ de zhu ba las byung ba'i dang po'i rdo rjer gyur/ de lag tu gtad la/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad nyid/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag na gnas/ khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang*/ /phyag na rdo rje brtul zhugs brtan/ / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta siddhi badzra sa ma ya tiṣṭha e ṣa st+waṃ dha ra ya mi badzra sa twa hi hi hi hi hūṃ hūṃ/ gsum pa ni/ g.yon chos gos kyi grwa snying gar 'dzin tshul dang*/ g.yas mchog sbyin byas la/ slob dpon oṃ yig las byung de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa'i skur gyur pa'i mos pa gyis zhes brjod la/ oṃ rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /'dir ni ngas khyod lung bstan bya/ /srid pa shin tu grub pa'i phyir/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro rnams las bton/ /kyai che ge mo rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ta thā ga ta siddhi sa ma ya st+waṃ/ bhur bhu waḥswaḥ gang 'di dag las byung ba'i phyag rgyas lung ston par byed pa de la de bzhin gshegs pa 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad mgrin gcig tu bla na med pa yang dag pa rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung ston par mdzad de/ 'di nyid las byung ba'i phyag rgya'i mthu dang*/ sngags 'di'i stobs kyis so/ / zhes dad par bya'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ 'dod chags bral ba lta bu'i sdig /khams gsum na ni gzhan med de/

/de bas 'dod la chags bral ba/ khyod kyis nam yang mi bya'o/ /mahā sa ma ya ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ lnga pa ni/ mchog tu gsang ba dam pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor mthong shing zhugs pa yis/ /sdig pa kun las nges par grol/ /de ring khyod rnams legs par gnas/ /bde chen theg pa 'di la ni/ /phyin chad 'chi ba khyed la med/ /srid pa shin tu grub pa'i phyir/ / srid pa'i sdug bsngal las khyod 'das/ / rdo rje'i phyag rgya gang yin pa/ /gang zhig bskyed pa tsam gyis ni/ /sangs rgyas nyid du the tshom med/ /byang chub sems ni spang mi bya/ /dam pa'i chos ni sun mi dbyung*/ /nam yang dor bar mi bya'o/ / mi shes pa'am rmongs pa yis/ /de nyid nges par bstan mi bya/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya rnams/ /nam yang dor bar mi bya'o/ /slob dpon smad par mi bya ste/ / 'di ni sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /rang gi bdag nyid yongs spangs nas/ / dka' thub kyis ni mi gdung zhing*/ /ci bde bar ni bde ba bzung*/ /'di ni ma byon rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /de ring khyod nyid dkyil 'khor gyi/ /slob dpon sngags dang rgyud 'dzin par/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ /lha rnams kun gyis mthun par dgongs/ /sems can rnams la rjes brtse bas/ khyod kyis dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhin/ /rab tu 'bad de bri bar bya/ /sgrub pa po rnams rgyud la sbyor/ / zhes brjod/ dbang gzhi nub gcig la byed pa'i tshe/ mtha' rten 'di thams cad dbang bzhi pa'i mthar byed pa dpal 'dzin gyi gzhung gi dgongs pa yin cing*/ lugs rnying gi yi ge 'ga' zhig na yang mngon du snang ngo*/ /de ltar na rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du zhugs shing*/ bum pa'i dbang bskur bas/ lus kyi dri ma dag / bskyed rim dang thun mong gi dngos grub/ las tshogs dang bcas pa sgrub pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu sprul sku mngon du gyur pa'i rten 'brel legs par tshogs pa'o/ / zhes rtogs pa bskyed do/

/ gnyis pa ni/ phyag dang maṇḍal phul la/ e ma ho/ sangs rgyas slob dpon che/ / e ma ho chos dang tshogs kyi gtso/ /dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol/ /byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol/ / zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab/ gong gi sngags kyis gdong g.yogs bcings*/ slob dpon bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed/ yum rdo rje ro langs mar gyur/ yum gyi mkha' nas atma ko3haṃ/ rjes chags snyoms par zhugs pa'i mchog tu dga' ba'i sgras/ sangs rgyas sras dang*/ btsun mor bcas pa'i tshogs rnams spyan drangs/ spyi bo nas zhugs/ byang chub kyi sems su gyur pa dga' ba bzhi'i ye shes brtan par byas pa'i thig le nor bu las/ mthe bong dang ming med kyis blangs te/ byin par mos shig /btung ba rin chen dam pa 'di/ /rdo rje'i lus ni rab sgrub byed/ /bu khyod de ltar shes gyis kye/ /yid las byung ba'i chu 'thung zhig /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ zhes thod pa dang po nas bdud rtsi sbyin/ a ho mahā su khaṃ zhes rjes zlos bya/ shes rab kyi mkha' nang na gnas pa'i byang chub kyi sems kyang khar babs par mos/ zhes brjod la/ ka pā la gnyis pa nas bdud rtsi sbyin/ de nas 'bru gsum gyis gdong g.yogs 'grol lo/ /de ltar na/ bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du zhugs shing*/ gsang ba'i dbang bskur/ ngag gi dri ma dag / rdzogs rim steng sgo'i rnal 'byor sgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu longs sku mngon du 'gyur ba sogs rtogs pa bskyed do/ /gsum pa ni/ phyag dang maṇḍal phul/ ji ltar bla med dpa' bo yis/ / mgon la dbang ni bskur ba ltar/ /bla med byang chub gnas bya'i phyir/ /mgon pos bdag la dbang bskur bya'o/ / zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab la/ gong bzhin mig dar bcing*/ de nas rig ma mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa dngos grub kyi don du/ khyed rang rnams la gtad par mos shig / gzung ma yid 'ongs 'di khyod kyi/ /bsten byar sangs rgyas rnams kyis brtags/

/rdo rje rjes chags sbyor ba yis/ /bde ba dam pa myang bar gyis/ /thabs gzhan gyis ni sangs rgyas min/ /'gro gsum 'di yang dag pa yin/ /de phyir khyod kyis rtag tu ni/ /'khor bar sbyor bral ma byed cig /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rig pa'i brtul zhugs bla na med/ / rmongs pa gang zhig 'da' byed pa/ /dngos grub mchog kyang yod ma yin/ / de nas/ lha mo des kyang*/ tsan dan dang*/ gur gum la sogs pas byug cing*/ dri zhim pos me tog gi 'phreng bas mngon par brgyan nas/ phyogs kyi gos can rab tu rgyas pa'i padma gsal bar byas te/ dri chen dri chu bza' ba ste/ khrag dang khu ba de bzhin sha /bud med mchog gus de bzhin du/ /bha ga'i padmar tsum pa ni/ /bu khyod spro ba yin nam ci/ /ji ltar bde bar bu smros shig / ces dris par mos la/ dri chen dri chu sogs bza' ba/ /lha mo ci phyir bdag mi spro/ /bud med mchog tu rtag gus bya/ /bha ga nyid la tsu ma pa nam/ / zhes lan btab par mos shing*/ rjes zlos bya/ de nas des/ e ma nga yi padma ni/ / bde ba thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ /gal te cho gas bsten byed na/ /de'i mdun na nga gnas te/ /sangs rgyas mnyes pa la sogs pa/ /padmar bya ba ji bzhin byed/ /bde chen rgyal po rang nyid ni/ /'di nyid du ni brtag tu bzhugs/ /bhañdza mokṣa ho/ zhes gsung par bsam/ de nas slob dpon gyi de kho na nyid bstan pa ni/ rnal 'byor pa yis byang chub sems/ /ji srid 'byin par mi byed par/ /de srid thob 'gyur rgyun mi 'chad/ /dga' ba las skyes bde gzhan ci/ /dngos grub kun gyi gter gyur pa/ /byang chub sems ni lhung gyur na/ /rnam shes phung po brgyal 'gyur bas/ /ma smad dngos grub ga la yod/ /mkha' dbyings rdo rje'i kun sbyor dang*/ /reg byas kyis ni rmad byung che'i/ /dga' ba bskyed par byed pa gang*/ /de ni mchog dga' byed pa'o/

/dga' bral dag gi dbus su ni/ /mtshon pa ltos la brtan par gyis/ /padma'i nam mkha' rdo rje yi/ /lte bas mnan pa'i gnas dag tu/ /rdo rje'i skyil krung gis sems ni/ /nor bu'i nang du gnas blta bas/ /ye shes skye ba gang yin de/ /ye shes ngo bo zhes bya ste/ /'dod chags ma yin chags bral min/ /dbu mar dmigs par mi 'gyur ro/ /gang tshe rnal 'byor ye shes mthong*/ /de la gnas bya 'gyur mi bya/ /thun nam yang na nyin gcig gam/ /zla phyed zla ba lo dang ni/ /bskal pa'am bskal bapa stong du yang*/ /ye shes mngon sbyor gyis gnas bya/ / zhes brjod cing don bshad/ slob ma dang*/ rig ma mi dmigs te stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las/ 'khor lo'i gtso bo yab yum du gsal ba'i yum gyi mkha' nas atma ko3haṃ/ lugs 'byung lugs ldog gi dga' ba bzhi'i rim pas lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes dam pa mngon du byas/ zhes brjod/ 'bru gsum gyis gdong g.yogs bkrol/ de ltar na byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor/ gsang ba'i dbang*/ yid kyi dri ma/ rdzogs rim pho nya'i lam bsgom pa la/ 'bras bu chos sku/ rtogs pa bskyed/ bzhi pa ni/ phyag dang maṇḍal phul la/ byang chub rdo rje

sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ mig dar bcing bkrol dbang 'di la dgos pa ni ma yin mod/ byed na snga ma rnams kyi rigs 'gre'o/ /de nas 'di skad ces/ dbang bzhi pa'i don ni/ rgyud kyi rgyal po las/ byang chub med cing mngon rtogs med/ /dngos po med cing sgom pa med/ khams med rnam par shes pa med/ /nam mkha' dag ni mnyam nyid gnas/ /nam mkha' lta bur bdag med pas/ /chos 'di bde ba chen po'o/ /zhes gsungs shing*/ de nyid sgom pa'i tshul ni/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug birwa pas/ /'di nyid gsal zhing stong pa dang*/ /rig pa'i de nyid ma 'gags pa/ /rang rig ye shes skad cig ma/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar te/ rang bzhin spros bral bde ba chen po la bde stong gi sems bzo bcos med pa'i tshul gyis mnyam par zhog cig / ces pa'am/ spro na dbang bzhi pa'i don rgyas par bshad do/ /de ltar na/ don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor/ bzhi pa'i dbang*/ sgo gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa dag /shin tu spros pa med pa'i rnal 'byor bsgom/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku/ rtogs pa bskyed do/ / gnyis pa rjes ni/ mtha' rten rnams 'dir byas na de rnams kyang yin la/ khyad par dam tshig brjod cing gzengs bstod pa ni/ nges par 'dir bya ba yin ste/ mchog du gsang ba dam pa nas/ 'chi ba khyed la med/ srid pa shin tu zhi bya'i phyir/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro las khyod 'das/ /srid pa shin tu grub pa'i phyir/ /ston pa mchog tu yang dag 'gyur/ /dngos grub dam tshig sdom pa 'di/ khyod kyis rtag tu bsrung bya ste/ / sangs rgyas kun gyis mthun par gsung*/ /mchog tu rtag pa'i bka' yin no/ / slob dpon smad par mi bya ste/ /bde gshegs bka' las 'da' mi bya/ /de bzhin khros nas spun rnams la/ /nyes pa brjod par mi bya'o/ /sems can rnams la byams pa'i sems/ /nam yang nges par btang mi bya/ /byang chub sems ni dor mi bya/

/rang gzhan chos la mi smad do/ /yongs su ma smin sems can la/ /gsang ba nyid ni bstan mi bya/ /bdag nyid phung po smad mi bya/ /chos rnams ngo bo sun mi dbyung*/ /gdug la byams pa rtag tu spangs/ /chos nyid tshad bzung mi bya'o/ /dad ldan sems can bslu mi bya/ /rtag tu dam tshig brten par bya/ /shes rab rang bzhin bud med la/ /skyon gyi nyes pa mi brjod do/ /rnal 'byor slong mos mi rgyu zhing*/ /rnal 'byor spang bar mi bya ste/ /rtag par rgyun du gsang sngags bzlas/ /rtag tu dam tshig la sogs brten/ /gal te bla ma smod de bzhin/ /dam tshig bag med gyur pa ni/ /de tshe dkyil 'khor nges bris la/ / bde gshegs rnams la sdig pa bshags/ /deng khyod skye ba 'bras bur bcas/ / gang phyir 'di la legs par gnas/ /dam tshig lhag rnams dang mnyam par/ / gnas par 'gyur bar the tshom med/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje can bcas pa/ /kun gyis tshe ldan de dbang bskur/ /khams gsum gyis ni rgyal srid che/ /rgyal ba'i bdag por bstan pa yin/ /de ring bdud las rnam rgyal zhing*/ /grong khyer mchog tu rab zhugs so/ /de ring khyod nyid sangs rgyas nyid/ /thob par 'di la the tshom med/ /de ltar yid ni rab dang rdo rje nyid du gyis/ /rang gis dam tshig mi bzad bde ster brten par gyis/ /de ring 'gro ba bde myur rdo rje sems dpa' dang*/ /mtshungs pa'i rtag pa nyid du khyed rnams brten par gyis/ / zhes brjod/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' bstsal pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyid/ / ces rjes zlos bya/ gtang rag gi don du maṇḍal 'bul/ deng nas brtsams te sogs dang*/ dge ba byang chub tu bsngo/ de nas bden stobs brjod pa ni/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med/ /bzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las yang dag byung/ /de ni de nyid nges par 'byung*/ /bden pa de yis dkyil 'khor ni/

/gzugs brnyan gsal bar slob ma rnams/ /kun gyi sgrib med mthong bar shog / lan gsum brjod do/ / slob ma sta gon dang slob ma dbang skur ba bya ba ni dbang chog 'khrul ba'i dri bral du shes par bya'o/ /'grub na sbyin sreg bya zhing*/ slob ma'i lag pa nas 'jus la bgang blugs gsum mam bdun phul la 'dod don gsol ba btab/ slob mas kyang skabs 'dir yon 'bul lo/ /gzhan yang gtor ma dang*/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo la sogs pas kyang lha mnyes par bya ste/ de ltar yang*/ lha ni mnyes par ma byas na/ /bdag nyid rnam par sun 'byin yin/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ / gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba ni/ nangs par nyi ma 'char kar gyur pa na/ mchod pa rnams kha gsos/ gong bzhin byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ hrīḥṣtīḥha/ sogs kyis phyi mchod dang*/ gong bzhin nang mchod dang*/ a ye kye kye sogs kyis bstod cing*/ sna tshogs pa'i rol mo'i sgra bya/ bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed pa'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyis/ bdag dang sems can thams cad la thugs brtse bar mdzad du gsol/ bdag la zhi ba la sogs pa'i las kyi dngos grub dang*/ 'jig rten dang*/ 'jig rten nas 'das pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa bstsal du gsol/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba dang*/ sems can rnams bde skyid 'phel bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes 'dod don zhu yig brgya mang du bzlas pa'i mthar/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ oṃ khyed kyi sems can sogs lan gsum gyi mthar/ oṃ badzra muḥ zhes ye shes pa rnams gshegs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa rang la thim/ lha'i nga rgyal dang*/ stong nyid kyi lta ba brtan pos a kā ro 'i sngags dang*/ chos thams cad ni skye ba med pa'o/ / chos thams cad ni dngos po med pa'o/ / zhes brjod cing*/ sarba bi ghnanbha dza dha ra adzñā pa ya ti hūṃ/ rdo rje rtse mos shar sgo nas brtsams te/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor dbyi'o/

/mthar las rjes mi mngon par bya zhing*/ phur bu dngos su btab na/ skam pa'i phyag rgyas/ oṃ badzra kī la kī la ya hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa ho zhes phyung*/ tu tu sphu tu sogs kyis shul 'o mas bgang*/ yid kyis btab pa la ni mi dgos so/ /rdul tshon chu bor spyan 'dren ni gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /de nas smon lam dang*/ bkra shis rgya cher bya zhing*/ slar yang dge 'dun la ston mo bya zhing*/ slob dpon 'khor bcas tshogs kyis mnyes par bya'o// // 'dir smras pa/ 'di la cho ga yi ge mang yod kyang*/ / bzang po 'ga' zhig deng sang lag len dka'/ /lag len bde 'ga' legs pa'ang min mthong nas/ /skyon bral yon tan ldan pa 'di sbyar ro/ /gal te nongs na blo yi nyes par zad/ /drang po'i bsam pa na yang zhig pa med/ /chos tshul 'di la mchog tu gus pa'i blos/ /legs sbyar 'di yang blo ldan dga' byed yin/ /bdud bzhi mthar byed 'jam dpal dpa' bo yi/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga bris pa'i dge ba yis/ /'gro kun lhan cig skyes pa'i dngos po ni/ /zung 'jug snying po'i gnas la reg par shog/ // ces pa'ang don gnyer mang pos bskul ba'i ngor/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas rang lo sum cu so bzhi son pa la/ dpal jo mo nang gi ri khrod du sbyar ba'o/ /dge legs 'phel// bod kyi brda sprod pa sngags 'chang blo gros rnam rgyal gyis chos spyod bcu'i phyir du bris/ / mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed dmar lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bzhugs/ - PAGE 314 -- PAGE 257 -- PAGE 256 -
